chapters.title: Chapter 351: Making His Appearance
paragraphs: "Hmmm, a mysterious ore hidden somewhere in the wild forest, huh? I wonder what it’s made of," Kent muttered as he combed through the memories of Bright Faywood, who died without knowing how it happened.
Kent was told to kill and retrieve Bright’s memories when he got the quest a few months back.
The aim of the quest was to get his memories.
This would let him know where to go next and who to kill next. Though there would be quests for that, getting to know in advance would be useful.
But now that Bright was dead, he got something even better. He now had the location of a mysterious ore found years ago when he was exploring the wild forest and got lost.
Thankfully, he found his way back, but not before discovering something this grand.
Before his death, Bright was planning on getting the battle dolls from Kent, and strangely, he had a way to upgrade them.
This shocked Kent, knowing someone had a different method to enhance the strength of his battle doll further.
However, now that Bright was no longer alive, he could only get the ore despite knowing monsters beyond one’s understanding would protect it.
It has been years since Bright discovered the ore.
Per his memories, the ore would have surfaced years again due to natural events or beasts discovering it. But he is also confident it would still be there, waiting to be claimed.
"I will just handle the rescue mission first and then prepare for that later," Kent said.
He stood up and stretched. Bright Faywood’s body had been discovered, and it was chaotic at the moment in his mansion.

But Kent didn’t care, for he had completed the quest that gave him another memory key, some items he would check later, and the location of a metal ore, possibly a meteor like the one he used on Veydris
That was a good harvest.
"I must first visit the auction house and see how many came for the Spirit Enlightenment Fruit," Kent said.
He took to the air and started flying away. Now a Great Sage, moving through the air was not something he found difficult.
He passed by where the battle had happened, and from the devastation below, he could only shake his head and wonder who would be foolish enough to come after him again.
He had heard what Bright and his guard talked about, and he could tell that aside from the body of the forest king, people now wanted to get their hands on his treasures.
They wanted his five battle dolls, and they also wanted his money.
Naturally, he had already started planning to kill every last one without hesitation.
Since he had become a Great Sage and had tens of thousands of points yet to be distributed, he knew Transcendents wouldn’t threaten him much now.

The three metal saints he had killed may have been blacksmiths rather than warriors, but he knew they could not kill him even if he were to face true warriors. As for Ascendants, he already had contingency plans against them.
Some had been hurt during the battle and retreated, with a few escaping unscathed, so he knew they would be coming after him.
As to when they will, he would wait for them to come.
He passed by the battlefield and soon arrived at the borders of Caprath City. After moving for a few kilometers, he appeared at the gate of the City.
"Identify yourself! Don’t you know there’s a no-flying rule in this city?" a guard shouted at Kent, who flew down and landed in front of the city gate.
"I wasn’t flying above the city," Kent replied, looking at the guard with a frown.
"I don’t have all day, brat. Identify yourself and state your business here. This city is no longer a place for casual visits, so don’t make things hard for me," the guard snapped.
Kent narrowed his eyes at the guard, who looked rather smug.
It seemed that after the Ashlands’ demise, the management of the city had become a headache. This even made guards become arrogant toward anyone.
He suspected as much, so he didn’t get angry at him. But he wasn’t friendly also because he didn’t have time for such nonsense.
"I am Kent Madson, and I am not coming to this city; I am just passing through," Kent revealed his name, causing the guard to look at him wildly.
"Hahaha, if you are Kent, then I am a Kingdom protector." The guard laughed, drawing the attention of his fellow guards and others trying to enter the city.
"John, would you believe this brat? He said his name was Kent—the same Kent who fought against the Evil Sect and hundreds of warriors and walked away alive.
How many of him have we gotten this week alone?" he asked, causing his fellow guards to laugh at Kent, making the purple-haired brat look at all of them with pity.
"I’m sure he thinks saying such a name will grant him access to the city. Brat, you better turn around and crawl back to wherever you came from before I make you."
Even those trying to enter the city were looking at Kent disdainfully.
Most had tried to use his name to enter the city, but they only met ridicule and insults. Now, the real deal was entering the city, but he wasn’t getting access because of all those people.
"Well, I tried to do this the easy way. Next, I’ll use the hard way, so don’t blame me if you die accidentally," Kent smirked and walked back.
"That’s right, go away, brat. We’ve had enough of you peasants trying to use the name of such a brave young man to enter the city and do whatever you want."
Kent smiled and then waved his hand. Suddenly, four metal dolls appeared with their weapons drawn, shocking everyone.
"Destroy the guard," Kent gave the order, and the dolls, who only needed a command from their master, sprang into action.
"No, wait!"
One of the guards acted swiftly, stepping in to stop the events that were about to unfold. The guard who had been running his mouth just moments ago stood frozen, unsure of what to say.
"I tried to enter using my name, but you didn’t allow me. Since I have somewhere to go and little time to get there, I can only use the hard way to pass."
Kent didn’t even bother with the expressions on the faces of those around him. They all stared at him as if he were some kind of idol.
"Please, you can enter... It was our mistake for doubting you."
Kent smirked and walked through the gate that was opened for him. He didn’t even bother to look back at the guard.

"Andy, you can pack your stuff and go. You are no longer required at the gate." After Kent was gone, the head of the guards spoke, and the guard realized he had made a huge mistake by looking down on everyone.
If Kent had arrived in a luxurious carriage, the guard would have probably kissed his feet and sucked up to him like a degenerate.

chapters.title: Chapter 352: Back to Westport City
paragraphs: It took him a couple of hours, but Kent managed to enter Vastport City quietly this time.
He wasn’t even stopped at the entrance, so he quickly made his way toward the Silver Leaf Auction House, which was still doing thousands in business even after the auction.
"Welcome back, distinguished customer," Kent, who had quickly made his way toward the room where he received his items, was greeted warmly.
"Please, I would like to meet someone. She is expecting me," Kent said, and the lady nodded.
"Indeed, my lady left word that if you were to appear here, you should be directed to VIP Room One," the lady smiled.
"Kindly follow me."
Kent nodded and started following her. Soon, they were in front of VIP Room One.

"You may enter," the lady said. Kent nodded and entered the room. The moment he did, he came face to face with a dark-veiled lady who, despite staring at her, gave the impression that her presence was not entirely there.
It was as if she was both in and out of existence.
"You are finally here," her voice, however, was human and full of energy.

"I am here, my lady," Kent said as he sat down. He knew the being in front of him was the strongest in the world, considering the peak of this world was the Core Formation stage, and she was at that stage.
"My lady, huh? Someone of your wealth and background shouldn’t call me that way," she smiled behind her veil.

"That’s the thing, my lady. I don’t have any background. If you look, you wouldn’t find anything about me. So, calling you ’my lady’ is more than polite, pleasant, and perhaps... sexy," Kent smiled, and the lady smiled as well.
"Why is it sexy?" she asked.
"Calling you ’Kingdom Protector’ is meh. Also, calling you ’the lady in the veil’ isn’t that cute. But ’my lady’? That, I can work with."
"Haha, you are funny," the lady laughed, making Kent smile as well.
"Not many can be this calm in front of me if they knew I am a Kingdom Protector. But I guess you are built differently. Your confidence matches your strength."
She smiled, remembering how Kent and his brute handled the bat, who, despite winning against them, still lost and was now hiding in a cave, thinking that would make any difference.
"I try to balance the two. Without strength, overconfidence can only result in your early death—and perhaps a good beating."
"So, are you confident you can navigate the current dangers surrounding you?" the lady asked.
"I believe all those tired of living should approach me. I don’t mind taking possession of their bodies, souls, and wealth."
"They are in the thousands."
"I don’t mind."
"Most are Root Ascensions and ancient battle-hardened beings."
"I’ll cross that bridge when I get there."

"What about against the Root Sovereigns? The one you fought against had just broken through. And in case you don’t know, the difference between a level 1 and level 2 Sovereign is akin to the gap between heaven and earth.
Can you confidently say you will be able to escape or defend against the attack of such beings?"
Kent didn’t answer. He just smiled and recalled what Akira had told him about the Guardian Knights of Sabatan.
He knew he was strong, but he wasn’t at the level to be fighting Sovereigns—at least not until his swordsmanship reached a certain stage.
In fact, he knew that without gaining Transcendence, going against Sovereigns would be dangerous. But he wasn’t alone.
He had Kaizo, who would soon break through into the Ascension stage, and Veydris, who was sitting at the peak of the Transcendent stage but could solo an Ascension stage expert.
If anything, the question should be whether or not the Sovereign would be able to leave after getting humiliated by a brat and his abnormal subordinates.
"A wise man once said, ’The metal is arrogant because of its hardness, but the moment it is submerged in fire, it becomes soft and can be beaten into any shape.’" Kent’s smile bloomed.
"I’m not saying I alone can beat a Sovereign, but when the time comes, I won’t be lying on the ground oozing blood.
I will stand and smile at them, for they don’t have what it takes to kill me." His confidence was oozing, making the lady smirk under her veil.
"You should be careful. There are many dangers already chasing after you, some in hiding, just waiting for you to slip up so they can swoop in and take everything."
"I will heed your advice, my lady," Kent nodded to her warning.
"It’s good to hear that." She took out a spatial ring and handed it over to Kent. "Only 14 were deemed worthy to receive the Spirit Enlightenment Fruit, considering most tried to come after you."
"Thank you, my lady, but I don’t really need this. I just wanted to see those who still have some dignity. At least 14 are still humans at heart."
He gave back the spatial ring to the lady and asked for something instead.
"In exchange for these fruits, I would like to know the names of these 14 who qualified for them." The lady nodded and retrieved a scroll from her spatial ring.
"I have their names, professions, and everything else you will need to locate them," she said, handing the scroll to Kent.
"Thank you, my lady." He smiled as he placed the scroll away.
"You can just call me Big Sister Vari. You can always come and visit me if you want to talk."
Kent nodded and stood up. He wanted to walk away but stopped and took out a Dark Golden Ambrosia Apple.
"Take this as payment for helping me with my troubles." Visibly, Kent could tell she was shocked, as her hands shook for a moment when he placed the apple in her palm.
"Then I’ll be on my way now, Big Sister Vari. I’ll see you soon enough, and perhaps, next time, we can grab dinner and see where this new connection takes us."
His smile contained something else as he walked away, leaving the poor lady to look at his retreating back and sigh.
"Just who are you, Kent Madson?" She looked at the fruit in her hands, and her body shuddered.
"I can finally reach the third stage and even have the chance to rise to the peak the moment my Spirit Core upgrades."

chapters.title: Chapter 353: Meeting Nara Again
paragraphs: Kent left the auction house and immediately entered a restaurant to book a private room.
He could already sense people following him, and since he had no plans of fighting just yet, he entered the tower right away.
The moment he entered, he connected to Saintess Selene’s mansion inside the sect and appeared there.
The tower places markers everywhere he enters or exits, so this was like quick travel for him. The moment he appeared inside the mansion, he sat down and activated the Astra Projection skill.
His soul and consciousness left his body and flew toward the sect master’s mansion. When he arrived, it was the same as before—deserted and quiet.
He quickly made his way into the underground cave and sped toward the two cages. He had already been there, so he knew the way.
He made sure he was in bat form. A few seconds after entering the cave, he landed on a wall a few meters from the two cages.
He looked at the ladies meditating, and a smile appeared in his mind.
The last time he was there, Zaila was on the floor of the cage, crying. That sight had worried him, but now, it seemed Nara had found a way to tell her they would be free soon.
Kent waited for a few minutes and then chose to talk to her.
[Hello there, Nara. It’s me again.] Kent’s voice entered her mind, causing the lady to open her eyes and look toward the bat that flapped its wings as if it were waving at her.
⟪So, of all the animals in the world, you chose to be a bat. You know I hate bats, right?⟫ A smirk appeared on her face, showing how happy she was to hear Kent’s voice in her head again.
[You’re not wrong about that. I also hate bats. In fact, I recently fought and nearly died against some idiots who cultivate bats. But this is convenient to blend in] Kent answered.
⟪It wouldn’t happen to be Evil Bat, would it?⟫ Nara asked.
[Do you know him or something?] Kent, who knew he was about to get some juicy gossip, asked.
⟪He tried to kill me with his bats years ago. Of course, he ran with his tail between his legs. I wonder what he’s up to these days.⟫ Nara looked happy, recalling the good old days.
She and Evil Bat clashed in a battle that lasted for 45 minutes, and through it all, Evil Bat was beaten black and blue despite putting up a good fight.
[He is a sovereign now, but as to whether he is doing good—well, he’s fucked for life, so be happy knowing that.]
⟪At least he’s still alive. The moment I recover my strength and cultivation base, I will kill him.
Had it not been for the battle between him and me, the sect master wouldn’t have realized I had a strand of sword will.
If only I had hidden it well enough, he wouldn’t have come after me when he did. So, aside from killing the sect master, I will kill that idiot too.⟫
Kent was shocked to hear she had a strand of sword will. However, instead of asking, he chose to wait until after she was free to get into it.
[Then take solace in knowing that after your rescue, I plan on destroying the entire Evil Sect. You can join in on that raid.]
⟪I will,⟫ she said with a smile.
⟪By the way, how is my baby sister? Has she fallen for you already?⟫ Nara asked, already knowing that Kent was interested in her from the way he talked about her the last time he was there.
[Oh, she’s fallen alright. She even danced for me, and I have to say, she’s really good with her hips and ass.]
A smile appeared on Nara’s face, but it vanished the next second. She didn’t want anyone to suspect she was talking to someone.
⟪Mara is indeed good with her ass. I can already see her making your other women jealous,⟫ Nara said, smiling again.
She just couldn’t help herself.
Perhaps Kent shouldn’t have told her about all his amazing wives, who are supportive of each other but also competitive in their own way.
[They’re jealous, alright, but there’s nothing they can do about it. However, aside from Mara dancing for me, I also learned you were her teacher. Care to bust a few moves after your rescue?]
This time, Nara covered her face as a blush appeared on her cheeks.
⟪That brat! She even snitched on me when she knew I hated dancing. I’ll be sure to discipline her when I’m out of here.⟫
Kent didn’t dive into it much. He is a bat, so expressions to him are just moving his head. But hearing she planned on disciplining her, he would certainly look forward to that.
[You do that. However, I came to inform you that in five days’ time, you and the lady beside you will be free. I’ve already put measures in place; it’s just a few finishing touches left.]
⟪Okay. Just take your time so you don’t fall into any traps the sect master has set. I’ve studied him and can tell he’s a very careful individual.⟫
[I’ll be careful. Just be ready, and find a way to tell the lady too. I can tell she’s not as composed as you are, so talking to her might raise suspicion.]
⟪I’ll let her know. Also, take it easy with Mara, okay? She’s very fragile.⟫
[Don’t worry. I haven’t dived in yet—we’re still testing the waters.] Kent would have probably exploded into laughter if he were in his human form.
The lady closed her eyes and covered her face. The brat just doesn’t hold back.
⟪I’ll hear all about it when I’m out of this place, then.⟫
[Be sure to plan that well because you’ll have years to spend with her and everyone in my life. Just wait a few more days.]
⟪Thank you, Kent. I’ll be sure to pay you back when I’m free.⟫
[Just a dance or two will be enough.]
⟪Then I’ll do well to entertain you for as long as I’m alive and well.⟫
[It’s a promise, then.]
Kent spent a few more minutes chatting about other things before flying away. He returned to his body and then reached out to Alina, who was with Lady Lani.
They were both in the Gate Master Mara’s residence, waiting for his arrival. He left to have a word with them before challenging the Sword Bridge again.
This time, he planned on winning.

He made sure he was in bat form.
A few seconds after entering the cave, he landed on a wall a few meters from the two cages.
He looked at the ladies meditating, and a smile appeared in his mind.
The last time he was there, Zaila was on the floor of the cage, crying.
That sight had worried him, but now, it seemed Nara had found a way to tell her they would be free soon.
Kent waited for a few minutes and then chose to talk to her.
[Hello there, Nara.
It’s me again.] Kent’s voice entered her mind, causing the lady to open her eyes and look toward the bat that flapped its wings as if it were waving at her.
⟪So, of all the animals in the world, you chose to be a bat.
You know I hate bats, right?⟫ A smirk appeared on her face, showing how happy she was to hear Kent’s voice in her head again.
[You’re not wrong about that.
I also hate bats.
In fact, I recently fought and nearly died against some idiots who cultivate bats.
But this is convenient to blend in] Kent answered.
⟪It wouldn’t happen to be Evil Bat, would it?⟫ Nara asked.
[Do you know him or something?] Kent, who knew he was about to get some juicy gossip, asked.
⟪He tried to kill me with his bats years ago.
Of course, he ran with his tail between his legs.
I wonder what he’s up to these days.⟫ Nara looked happy, recalling the good old days.
She and Evil Bat clashed in a battle that lasted for 45 minutes, and through it all, Evil Bat was beaten black and blue despite putting up a good fight.
[He is a sovereign now, but as to whether he is doing good—well, he’s fucked for life, so be happy knowing that.]
⟪At least he’s still alive.
The moment I recover my strength and cultivation base, I will kill him.
Had it not been for the battle between him and me, the sect master wouldn’t have realized I had a strand of sword will.
If only I had hidden it well enough, he wouldn’t have come after me when he did.
So, aside from killing the sect master, I will kill that idiot too.⟫
Kent was shocked to hear she had a strand of sword will.
However, instead of asking, he chose to wait until after she was free to get into it.
[Then take solace in knowing that after your rescue, I plan on destroying the entire Evil Sect.
You can join in on that raid.]
⟪I will,⟫ she said with a smile.
⟪By the way, how is my baby sister?
Has she fallen for you already?⟫ Nara asked, already knowing that Kent was interested in her from the way he talked about her the last time he was there.
[Oh, she’s fallen alright.
She even danced for me, and I have to say, she’s really good with her hips and ass.]
A smile appeared on Nara’s face, but it vanished the next second.
She didn’t want anyone to suspect she was talking to someone.
⟪Mara is indeed good with her ass.
I can already see her making your other women jealous,⟫ Nara said, smiling again.
She just couldn’t help herself.
Perhaps Kent shouldn’t have told her about all his amazing wives, who are supportive of each other but also competitive in their own way.
[They’re jealous, alright, but there’s nothing they can do about it.
However, aside from Mara dancing for me, I also learned you were her teacher.
Care to bust a few moves after your rescue?]
This time, Nara covered her face as a blush appeared on her cheeks.
⟪That brat!
She even snitched on me when she knew I hated dancing.
I’ll be sure to discipline her when I’m out of here.⟫
Kent didn’t dive into it much.
He is a bat, so expressions to him are just moving his head.
But hearing she planned on disciplining her, he would certainly look forward to that.
[You do that.
However, I came to inform you that in five days’ time, you and the lady beside you will be free.
I’ve already put measures in place; it’s just a few finishing touches left.]
⟪Okay.
Just take your time so you don’t fall into any traps the sect master has set.
I’ve studied him and can tell he’s a very careful individual.⟫
[I’ll be careful.
Just be ready, and find a way to tell the lady too.
I can tell she’s not as composed as you are, so talking to her might raise suspicion.]
⟪I’ll let her know.
Also, take it easy with Mara, okay?
She’s very fragile.⟫
[Don’t worry.
I haven’t dived in yet—we’re still testing the waters.] Kent would have probably exploded into laughter if he were in his human form.
The lady closed her eyes and covered her face.
The brat just doesn’t hold back.
⟪I’ll hear all about it when I’m out of this place, then.⟫
[Be sure to plan that well because you’ll have years to spend with her and everyone in my life.
Just wait a few more days.]
⟪Thank you, Kent.
I’ll be sure to pay you back when I’m free.⟫
[Just a dance or two will be enough.]
⟪Then I’ll do well to entertain you for as long as I’m alive and well.⟫
[It’s a promise, then.]
Kent spent a few more minutes chatting about other things before flying away.
He returned to his body and then reached out to Alina, who was with Lady Lani.
They were both in the Gate Master Mara’s residence, waiting for his arrival.
He left to have a word with them before challenging the Sword Bridge again.
This time, he planned on winning.

chapters.title: Chapter 354: Lady Lani
paragraphs: "Alina, do you think Kent will agree to an alliance with my auction house?" Lady Lani asked, sitting under a blossom tree somewhere in the Gate Master’s residence.
She is with Alina, Kent’s woman who was acting just to maintain her cover...for now.
"He will, big sister. He gave you the ambrosia fruit, didn’t he? So I doubt he will reject your offer to become partners," Alina replied, already waiting for how she would react when Kent arrived.
"Then do you think he will agree to also join the expedition to the Ancient Battlefield of Passing? He has proven to have what it takes to survive there."
"Just relax, big sister. I am here with you, so let me do the talking in case you cannot handle it," Alina said with a smile.
The look and behaviour of the auction master weren’t something new to her.
She could tell Lady Lani was both eager to see him yet still shy and perhaps afraid, considering she still hadn’t recovered from the events during the auction.
In fact, instead of recovering, she seemed to get worse every single day. The ladies ensured she got a good view of the action, so she could never recover that easily.
Not that she would ever want to recover. In a way, this was something new to her, so her curiosity was piqued.
Kent, who was on his way, had to stop and glare at the disciples of the Gate Master, who were proving to be stubborn.
"You do know that I can beat you all senseless, and your master wouldn’t do anything to me, right?" Kent said to Zayn and the rest of Gate Master Mara’s disciples.
"Master is not here, so go back," Zayn said.
"I am not here to see your master. I came for the two ladies currently living here," Kent replied.
"Unless Master allows you to enter, we cannot let you in," they said. They wouldn’t allow him in simply because they still hated him for what happened during the sword trial.
They still hadn’t recovered from that traumatizing event yet.
"Fine." Kent turned around and left the gate. The five disciples smiled, seeing they had made the brat return.
However, Kent, who had only moved 209 meters, smirked and blinked away. The next second, he was inside the large mansion, 3 kilometres from the five brats.
He had been there before, so teleporting inside wasn’t too hard.
The moment he appeared inside the mansion, he felt someone scan him.

He immediately recognised the person was much more monstrous, considering he barely felt their presence wash over him. He moved toward the direction of the presence, and soon, he could see two beauties sitting.
Lady Lani quickly covered her face with a veil when she felt Kent’s presence, considering she removed it before. But even so, Kent could already see her beauty. And this time, it was up close.
’Keep hiding your beauty, lady. I will see that face by the end of today,’ he smiled as he approached them.
"Ladies," Kent said, moving closer to Alina.
Without any hesitation, he took her hand and landed a kiss on her lips, shocking Lady Lani to the core. Even Alina never expected something like this to happen.
"No need to look so shocked, Lady Lani. Alina and I are together. She is my woman, and I am her man," Kent said, sitting beside the stunning beauty.
Lady Lani looked at Alina and then at the smiling Kent, sighing.
"Then I assume you are the perfect alchemist... There’s no way my Alina would hide his identity if he didn’t mean something like this to her."
Kent smiled.

"She had to keep me a secret so I could grow my strength. You already saw what happened during the auction. Back then, if they came after me because of how extraordinary I am, I would have been dead by now."
"I guess that makes sense," Lady Lani nodded, then glared at Alina. "Why didn’t you tell me it was him? I would have protected him."
Alina smiled. "Sorry, big sister. I just didn’t want to take any chances since he wasn’t ready to make his name known just yet."
"I see. I guess that also makes sense. But in the future, let me know, and don’t worry—I’ll do my best to protect him."
"Oh, I have no doubt you’ll be able to protect me. As the disciple of a Kingdom Protector, you are more than capable," Kent smiled, making the veiled lady raise an eyebrow.
"So, you’ve met Master already," she sighed. The brat is just too monstrous for someone who isn’t even half her strength.
"I met Big Sister Vari. She’s a wonderful lady," Kent smiled.
"Big sister?" both Alina and Lady Lani asked, their eyebrows raised.
"No need to look so shocked. Our relationship is a special one. If you don’t believe me, you can ask her later and see," Kent said, still smiling, while the two ladies looked both shocked and shaken.
"You do know Master is one of the strongest people in this world, right? How were you able to stay calm before her? I expected you to be shaken by now," Lady Lani asked.
Kent smiled.
"A wise man once said, ’A cultured man is never shaken when thrown into the lion’s den, for he knew he will walk out chewing the bones of the lion.’"
"Unbelievable," Alina said, shaking her head. She had heard of the Kingdom Protector before and knew she was someone only a few people had the privilege to meet.
For her man to have met her and walked away, even reaching the brother and sister stage with her, was just too much. Kent was simply extraordinary for someone his age and strength.
"Just don’t be too shocked, ladies. Sometimes, you can only accept what has happened and move on," Kent decided to end the teasing there.

After ensuring they had calmed down, he looked at the veiled lady and asked, "I presume coming here wasn’t just to listen to how amazing I am. So, why don’t we take the conversation to the Tasty Home Pavilion? We can talk over a hot meal."
Lady Lani glanced toward Alina, who she knew would be going with her man. This means she could only nod.
The next conversation would be about her attempt to recruit him. But then she remembered what Alina had said and could only sigh.
Alina told her she would do the talking, and with the sudden discovery that she was Kent’s woman, it was only natural to assume this conversation was already in the bag.
However, she also wants to try to make her voice heard, and since this was more like a formal request, she will try her best to get him on board.

chapters.title: Chapter 355: Dinner With Lady Lani and Alina
paragraphs: "You... How did you get in?" Zayn asked, watching Kent and the two ladies walk out of the mansion as they started to leave Gate Master Mara’s residence and head toward the Tasty Home Pavilion.
"We clearly saw you leave, so how did you enter?"
Kent smiled and smirked at the five brats who had been spoiled too much by their master, making them think everything was rainbows and sunshine.
"Kids, a wise man once said, ’When one door closes, thousands of windows open.’" His laughter filled the lush passage leading away from the mansion.
The ladies beside him held back their laughter, but smiles could be seen on their faces.

The five disciples gritted their teeth but could only watch as Kent and the ladies walked away. They would tell their master to fix the formation because someone had managed to break in without the formation stopping them.
After they left, Kent and the two ladies quickly found themselves inside the Tasty Home Pavilion, where he showed his platinum-grade badge and was immediately led to the top floor of the pavilion.
It took a few minutes for their orders to be brought to them.
The moment the food was set down, Kent started staring at Lady Lani, who was also looking at him.
"This was all your scheming, wasn’t it?" she asked.
"It’s only natural for a man to treat such a beauty like yourself to a good dinner. So, why don’t you dig in and tell me how delicious it is?" Kent’s smile bloomed as he looked at her.
Lady Lani just couldn’t understand how a person could be this shameless yet also very likeable.
She knew he planned on looking at her face without the veil, but she also didn’t want to take it off. She glanced at Alina, who was smiling at her.
Had the situation been different, perhaps Alina would have helped her. But now, she could only endure and follow through with it.
"Don’t fight it, Big Sister. He is that shameless, and from the moment you agreed to his dinner invitation, you had already fallen into his trap."
Lady Lani sighed and removed her veil, revealing her enchanting beauty.
"Are you happy now?" she asked, making Kent smile.
"More than you can imagine."
Alina just smiled on the side.
They started eating right afterwards. Since they were on the top floor, the dishes were the best the Pavilion had to offer. So every plate of food was the best of the best...
For an hour, they indulged in some of the finest delicacies.
After they had eaten their fill, they got down to business.
"So, to what do I owe the pleasure of a visit from such a beauty?" Kent asked, sipping on a spirit drink. Lady Lani sighed. Over the hour, she had somehow grown more comfortable being around Kent.

"I was hoping to see if we could form something akin to an alliance. My auction house and other businesses can provide you with what you need, and in return, if you have something of value to sell, you will use our services.
We will provide locations of treasures we know of but couldn’t handle the retrieval. We can even arrange a team to aid you should you need one.
All we ask is to use our services to handle the sale of such items.
It’s a win-win situation for both of us. So, what do you think?" Lady Lani asked.
"Not a bad deal." Kent nodded. "However, do you think your auction house has what it takes to handle the stuff I will be bringing?" he asked.
"Though I don’t like to brag, I am someone who has more than you can think of. In fact, if the Ambrosia Fruit is already enough to break your mind, then wait till you see the rest of my treasures."
Alina rolled her eyes at his clear bragging, despite him saying he didn’t like to brag.
But although he bragged to the lady, she start to look forward to such treasures .
In fact, she was now looking at Kent with puppy eyes. As someone who had seen and appraised loads of treasures, she started to drool over the potential treasures Kent would bring.
"Don’t worry about whether or not we can handle your treasures. Provided you have them, we can sell them even if it takes weeks of bidding."
"Okay then. You can rest assured I will deliver anything I want sold to your auction house," Kent promised her.
"Great," Lady Lani smiled, brightening her beauty even more.
"You should smile more, Lady Lani." Kent, of course, didn’t miss that chance to add his shameless suggestion.
"Then, do you want to join our expedition to the Ancient Battlefield of Parting? We know where the main chunk of the meteor is and how to safely get there.
The only hard part is retrieving it since, per our reports, it’s protected by three Sovereign-level spirit beasts.
However, the team, which will comprise 12 people, already has seven Ascension-stage experts and one Sovereign, leaving only five people left to complete the 12 able team.
If you were to join, your guardian would also be allowed another slot. You also wouldn’t have to complete the Calamity mission.
It was the requirement at first, but from your battles, we can tell you are capable. So we want you on board"
Since she had success asking for the alliance, she grew comfortable so she asked for another. This time, it was something Kent was actually looking forward to.
Getting the ore will help him to upgrade more battle dolls and create more undead he could use to enter even more harrowing places.
So hearing her request, Kent smiled.
"Hmm, that is some offer you have there, Lady Lani." But he pretended to be in a deep thought.
"Oh, please, I know you are thrilled, so why pretend?" Alina, however, had had enough of Kent’s antics, so she shattered all the facade he had around him.

"You demoness, why make it so obvious? But of course, Lady Lani, I will be thrilled to join the expedition. Don’t worry about giving a slot to that brute; he can get there without the help of the Sovereign. In fact, a few friends will be joining, but they won’t need a slot."
Lady Lani smiled. "If you say so, then I will inform the team."
"Big sister, you know you can be free around him, right? Holding back your happiness is not good for your health," Alina, however, wasn’t done.
She had shattered Kent’s facade, so she had to touch Lady Lani’s composure.
"You..." As expected, Lady Lani covered her face, embarrassed at being discovered. She was indeed very happy for she had succeeded in getting what she came for.
She had already thanked Kent on their way to the Pavilion and now, her two requests were accepted. But Alina just didn’t allow her to leave with her dignified expression.
"Don’t mind her, Lady Lani. I have spoiled her too much," Kent said, holding Alina’s waist and pulling her closer to himself.
"Do you want me to show you around the sect?" Kent asked.
"But you told me you only know two places, so where do you plan on taking her?" Alina giggled and looked at her big sister.
"Kent, dear, if you plan on wooing my big sister, then you should do better than this," Alina’s giggle turned into laughter, leaving Lady Lani blushing like a ripe tomato.

She had already thanked Kent on their way to the Pavilion and now, her two requests were accepted.
But Alina just didn’t allow her to leave with her dignified expression.
"Don’t mind her, Lady Lani.
I have spoiled her too much," Kent said, holding Alina’s waist and pulling her closer to himself.
"Do you want me to show you around the sect?" Kent asked.
"But you told me you only know two places, so where do you plan on taking her?" Alina giggled and looked at her big sister.
"Kent, dear, if you plan on wooing my big sister, then you should do better than this," Alina’s giggle turned into laughter, leaving Lady Lani blushing like a ripe tomato.

chapters.title: Chapter 356: Challenging The First Level of The Sword Bridge
paragraphs: "I will see you again, Lady Lani. Be sure to take me around Vastport City next time," Kent said to the veiled Lady after taking her to the Sword and Spear Gate, the only two places he knew in the sect.
"I will surely do that," she replied. Though she wanted to laugh, she held back and continued walking out of the sect.
"It seems some people still want a piece of you, Kent," she said, looking into the distance where hundreds of people could be seen camped up at the sect entrance.
Most of them were there to apologize on behalf of the wrongdoings of their family members who had gone against Kent. Naturally, they all started to get giddy when they saw him approaching.
The sect gate was opened, but none dared to enter.
Doing so would not only be an offence against the sect but also a disrespect to the elders of the sect, which would have many consequences, many of them severe, including death.
"I don’t have anything to do with them," Kent said, stopping abruptly. He turned and looked at Alina. "You can come visit me when you are free."
Alina nodded, knowing she would take him up on that offer.
He then turned to Lady Lani, "Sorry for not being able to walk you out. I have things to do, and getting close to them isn’t one of those."
He knew if he were to get closer to them, those who angered him would face his wrath, so it was better to leave them be.
"Don’t worry about that. We will talk when you come for the Pill Master competition," Lady Lani said, smiling behind her veil.
"Then we will see each other again," Kent said as the two ladies left. He could already sense some hidden dangers waiting for him outside.
Smirking, he vanished back into the sect.
The people waiting for him to come out were left stunned as he disappeared.
The moment he returned to Selene’s mansion, he entered the Sword Tower and quickly made his way to the Sword Bridge.
"This is going to be a good one," he muttered as he landed on the bridge and looked toward the large, colossal blade waiting for him to traverse.
It has 13 segments, and each is akin to a level he must be clear about before moving to the next level.
He moved forward, and the moment he entered the first segment, the white-armoured version of him appeared again. This was their second battle, and Kent had every intention of winning.
The clone held its sword inside a sheath, just like Kent’s.
"Alright, let’s see whether I can make a difference," Kent said.
He vanished and appeared in front of the clone, immediately going for a wide swing. His sword came out of the sheath and unleashed a wide arc of pure sword qi.
However, the clone was ahead of him, unleashing 100 sword arcs with a single swing to defend against the attack.
Then, it closed the gap between them again.
Kent exchanged a few sword strikes with the clone before pulling back.
’This is fun. But a slight mistake, and I am dead, so I must be careful,’ he thought.
He unleashed 100 sword arcs, but the clone destroyed them immediately. It then countered with 100 sword arcs and then vanished.
Unlike Kent, who still doesn’t have much experience in combat, the close was much more agile and quick with its attacks. So, it was handling the battle much more actively yet passively.
It vanished after unleashing the 100 sword arcs.
Kent became alert. The sudden disappearance was unexpected, so he heightened his focus.
"Shit," he realized what the clone was doing, but it was already too late. The clone appeared in the air and unleashed all 450 sword arcs at the same time.
Kent channelled his sword qi and intent, covering his immediate surroundings with all he had as the sword arcs rained down on him.
"Fuck!"
He was thrown back, landing heavily on the sword bridge. Then, as if his nightmare wasn’t over, he saw the white-armoured figure appear in front of him and thrust its sword.
But before the sword could reach him, Kent blinked away and reappeared in the air, unleashing his own 450 sword arcs.
He had to make a move, and the move was him coping with the attacks while he handled the dynamics of the battle. In simple terms, he must become the clone to defeat the clone.
He didn’t stop there. He unleashed the 72 Sovereign Sword Strikes right after the 450 sword arcs, forcing the clone to raise its guard and defend against the sword arcs and the chains.
But Kent was a step ahead again. He had to consider this as a battle he could not slack off.
He vanished, and the next second, he appeared behind the clone, which had made a mistake by using the vanishing act to try and kill the dragon.
Kent slashed at the leg of the clone, which jumped forward and rolled to the side. But that rolling was what Kent was aiming for.
"Got your ass," Kent smiled, stomping on the ground.
Just as he did, a dark, sharp shard shot from the ground, piercing through the right leg of the clone, who was caught off guard by the sudden attack.
’Now is the time to end the battle, but I must also be careful,’ Kent thought.
He moved forward and unleashed an elemental attack, sending a flaming sword arc flying toward the clone.
But just as his attack connected with the clone’s body, a smile appeared on his face.
He stabbed his sword behind him, piercing through the heart of the clone, which had split its body and tried to attack Kent from the back.
"I knew that vanishing act he used lasted longer than it should have," Kent said, patting himself on the back.
When the clone vanished, he expected a big surprise, and he got it. It was 450 swords arc right from the air.
However, he felt that the attack wasn’t the real deal.ree
So, he stayed alert and began looking for the loophole. Then, when he injured the clone, it became clear to him what the clone did.
He knew if it were to be him, he would have dodged that attack, and even if it had gone through his leg, he would have recovered and not been killed by the elemental attack.
So when the clone didn’t move during his attack, he knew it was a trap, so he focused on the surprise. As expected, it appeared, and he was ready.
This made him proud of himself and his keenness during the short yet dangerous battle.
The battle lasted only five minutes, but he got what he wanted, and it was more than he could have asked for.
The moment he pulled out his sword, the tower displayed the messages of his victory and rewards. The rewards were one he never expected, but they came.

⟪Congratulations on passing the first level of the sword bridge. Rewards: Your sword mastery has improved by 20%. You now have the mastery of the clone. You have received an active sword skill called Split Body Sword Strike.⟫

chapters.title: Chapter 357: Challenging The Second Level of The Sword Bridge
paragraphs: The wounds on his body were all healed instantly.
And it wasn’t his healing abilities that came into play.
No, the moment the battle was over, all the wounds he had sustained were healed. And, as if he had fought many battles before, he instantly gained mastery he never thought possible.
"Damn, this is the best cheat one could ever ask for."
Kent received the sword mastery that used to belong to the clone. Now feeling it in his bones, he knew it was more than he could have asked for.
The clone had perfect control of its skills and the sword. So, receiving its mastery was something worth celebrating.
Kent, who knew just how much he had been lacking, was now smiling, for he had closed that gap.
The feeling he was swimming in now was that of having the confidence to defeat the clone again in under a minute—if this were him before the duel.
"So, if I am not mistaken, the sword path is, first, to improve my swordsmanship and, second, to give me the mastery of the clones, which are far superior to me in all aspects.
And lastly, to gain the Split Body Sword Skill, which, from the description, will keep improving as the duel continues," Kent sighed with a smile.
"And I still have 12 more duels to fight." He clenched his fist in anticipation as he read about the Split Body Sword Skill.
⟪Split Body Sword Strike⟫
→ By utilizing sword qi and intent, you can create a copy of yourself that will possess all your skills and abilities and can be used whenever you deem necessary.
→ Until you deem it necessary, it will remain hidden from your opponent.
[Note: You can only split your body in two at this level of mastery. Passing more levels of the sword bridge will give you the ability to have more mastery over the skill]
"Wait, so basically, if the next level can split its body into three, after winning, I will also earn the three-way splitting," Kent asked himself, already feeling the headache coming.

⟪This also means the next level will have a more advanced level of your skills, and aside from its already superior strength and mastery, it will also have superior mastery over the Split Body Sword skill
The master has discovered the secrets of the sword bridge, but the next level will be a test to see just how much you can use the sword and how well you can adapt in battle.⟫
Gaia appeared in the air, smiling at Kent, who looked back and smiled. Though what Gaia just said means he will be fighting a rather monstrous version of the clone, his rewards will also be generous.
Plus, he was happy to see the Cosmic Loli finally appear after being away for months based on the tower time.
"You are finally here?" he asked.
⟪Yes, master. I am done with the remaining projects, except for the two you recently gave to Akira. Also, she told me you have a method to create the tower city.
And since you still haven’t rewarded me yet, I was hoping you would give me that as a reward. I will have a better use for it than you could ever dream of. After all, I am a cosmic weaver.⟫
Gaia smiled, extending her hand toward Kent, who could only curse at the cheeky anime lady who just had to run her mouth.
"Actually, I want you to have it. This way, you can create a vibrant city in the next five days. This means you have more than enough time inside the tower for this very important project.
But I want it done before the rescue." Kent sighed and handed her the Tower City Builder Token. Gaia is a cosmic weaver, so she is perfect for making the city look grand.
And he wants it grand before the two ladies are out of the cave and cages.
Since he promised Camilla and Mara that he would create a space for them to spend with the two ladies, he would make it happen.
⟪I will do my best, master. But after you are done, you can take your ladies to their various training spaces. You are the master of the two, so you know and can go anywhere.⟫
"Thank you, Gaia." The cosmic loli vanished, leaving Kent to ponder what to do next.
He had already seen how amazing the sword bridge was, and now, he couldn’t help but want to get down to business.
If the first level was this rewarding, then what would the second level be like.
"Dying the second time won’t be bad if it will allow me to at least know more about the next challenge and what I would be going against."
Kent accepted this reasoning, and so, taking his sword, he moved. Soon, he was inside the second level.
This time, a copy of him in green armor appeared, holding a green sword sheath housing a sword. Everything was the same as Kent except for the color.
Of course, he could tell the strength inside this clone was much stronger than the white clone. This means he is about to face a more advanced version of his perfect self.
The moment the clone appeared, a powerful sword qi and intent exploded out of its body, shaking the ground beneath Kent.
This forced him to move back, narrowly evading a dark shard aimed at his chest. The clone attacked instantly, taking him by surprise.
"Damn, that was aggressive." He moved to the side, and before he could land on the ground, another shard shot out of the ground.
This time, he blocked it with his sword sheath, pushing him back a few meters. The force behind that attack was so great that he had to retreat several meters just to stabilize himself.
But the moment he stabilized, he felt something lock onto his body. That was when he saw the clone raise its sword.
The sword was bathed in green sword qi, and from the look of things, it was level 8 sword qi, meaning Kent’s level 6 was insignificant in comparison.
The clone slashed its sword, unleashing a wide but thin vertical sword arc that flashed toward Kent, threatening to split him in half vertically.
But he didn’t just stand there and wait to be killed.
Kent also channeled his sword qi and imbued it with intent, taking a horizontal swing that released a sword arc. It instantly clashed with the clone’s vertical arc.
Kent quickly realized his sword arc was weaker, so he activated the True Despair Sword Strike, which managed to neutralize the attack.
But the moment that was dealt with, he noticed something that sent a chill down his spine. The clone was nowhere to be found.
It had literally vanished, and from how it happened, Kent’s blood ran cold. He knew this battle was not on the same level as the first one.

In fact, this battle was on a level he could never have anticipated. While the previous clone used both sword intent and qi for its attacks, this one used only sword qi, yet Kent had to use both to counter it.
This means if it were to use both sword qi and intent, things would become much more intense.
And now, it had vanished, possibly using the Split Body Sword Strike.
Kent narrowed his eyes, and then his eyes widened...

chapters.title: Chapter 358: A Different Kind of Battle
paragraphs: "Oh shit."
Kent muttered as he swung his sword, releasing 450 sword arcs at the clone, which appeared with the same 450 sword arcs as the first-level clone.
Kent, who had the same skill set as the clone, countered, but the outcome wasn’t too satisfactory.
The clone overpowered him, but before the sword arcs that passed through his defense could reach him, it blinked away and unleashed an elemental attack, summoning a flaming lion.
"72 String Sovereign Strike!"
Kent unleashed yet another skill, making sure he found his rhythm before the split bodies appeared. The attack released 72 razor-sharp, pointed chains made of sword qi.
The clone also unleashed the same skill, causing the 72 chains to clash mid-air. The attacks collided, creating a powerful shockwave.
Kent had to move back to avoid being pushed further. But he made sure to activate the Doom Shards, shooting them at the clone, which also activated the same attacks, forcing a smile onto Kent’s lips.
"I am fast, but this clone is faster, stronger, and more experienced than me." He took a long swing, defending himself against an attack from the clone.
"But I am human—or a dragon—which means I can scheme. That is also part of mastery and experience as a swordsman.
The ability to scheme against your opponent and win for the essence of combat or battle is to win and to win, you must use whatever scheme you can come up with to kill your opponent.
A good schemer, one who is skilled with the sword, will always win."
Kent knew he couldn’t match the clone’s raw power or speed head-on. But he had one advantage: creativity.
Using his points now isn’t ideal, for he is literally training to go against the odds. Using the points would defeat the purpose of this combat.
If he manages to kill the clone with his current mastery and experience, then when he adds the points to his stats, he can take what he has achieved to the next level.
The clone was a perfect replica of his skills, but it fought predictably, relying on sheer mastery rather than adaptability. Kent, on the other hand, could think outside the box.
The clone may be faster, but if he could create the perfect situation where it wouldn’t have that predictability to counter, he could kill it.
However, Kent didn’t want to do that yet until the split bodies made their appearance. Right now, the only thing he was aiming for was the appearance of the split bodies.
So he keeps doing his best to defend, stay alive and wait for them to appear.
15 minutes into the battle, the first split body appeared and instantly activated the [True Despair sword Strike,] forcing Kent to also counter using the sword slash skill.
This made him finally understand something that forced him to rethink the true nature of the skill. The moment the split body appeared, the main body he was fighting vanished.
This just doesn’t make sense if he were to compare this to the first level.
But then he realised something which forced him to make contingency plans.
"If I don’t kill this split body, I will have more issues on my hand" Kent unleashed 450 sword arcs, creating an explosion that caused the clone to move back.
This gave him two seconds to do whatever he wanted. The diversion worked as the clone was blocked by the smoke from the explosion.
So, he also split his body, and that was when his assumption was validated.
The moment he split his body, he saw the other two split bodies of the clone. Luckily, or perhaps it was just coincidence, the split bodies of the clone failed to register him.
They gave him the chance to attack and kill. But it must be done at the same time, or he won’t have any chances later.
So, he activated two attacks at the same time.
A dark shared stabbed through the body of one body, and he unleashed the True Despair Sword strike on another body, killing them instantly.
It was a big win for him.
On the other hand, the clone, who may have lost its split bodies, didn’t seem to care, nor did it falter in its attack.
It was attacking and defending, forcing Kent to keep going while his own split body got into position. It was like seeing from two different angles.
The clone perhaps didn’t notice him, or it just didn’t want to appear like it had noticed him, but Kent was moving in between attacks while unleashing his own.
Suddenly, the clone lunged forward, its sword a blur of green light. Kent sidestepped, parrying the strike with a precise flick of his blade.
The impact sent a jolt through his arms, but he held his ground. He countered with a quick slash aimed at the clone’s side, but the clone effortlessly deflected it, its movements fluid and efficient.
Kent retreated a few steps, creating distance.
He needed to buy time to formulate a plan. His own split body was now moving into position, for he knew he could not win without sacrificing a body. So he was doing all the planning...
The clone didn’t give him much room, though.
It pressed the attack, unleashing a flurry of sword arcs that forced Kent to dodge and block in rapid succession. Each strike was precise, each movement calculated to overwhelm him.
But Kent wasn’t just defending. He was observing. Slowly, he started to notice things...

He noticed a slight delay in the clone’s movements whenever it transitioned between attacks. It was minuscule, barely noticeable, but it was there. A flaw—or perhaps a limitation—in its otherwise perfect technique.
Kent smirked. "Got you."

chapters.title: Chapter 360: Awakening of the Dual Dragon Mage
paragraphs: During the primordial era, long before the eternal battle against the unknown, there was a unique dragon named Vaeltharion. She was a unique type of dragon due to two distinct aspects of her bloodline.
A very unique bloodline.
She was a dragon with both Absolute Ice and Everlasting Flame. They called her the Twin-Breath Tyrant, for her flame and ice were like the bane of existence, changing everything for everyone.
Her command over flame and ice made many people afraid of her. So, they did the only thing cowards do and schemed against her.
244 days.
That was how long it took to kill her. The Battle of Ice and Fire lasted for 244 days, during which the Twin-Breath Tyrant laid waste to civilizations and decimated countless armies and powerhouses.
However, it was all for nothing, for in the end, she couldn’t move ahead and become a dragon god, like the infamous Chaos Dragon.
So, in her last moments, she cried to the universe, and she listened.
"I may be dying, but my legacy will never die. I will rise again, and my fury will burn the landscapes of my foes, bathe civilizations in flames, and freeze the happiness of those who oppose me.
"I shall rise again, and my name will be known by Celestials, for the name that will carry the legacy of the Twin-Breath Tyrant will awaken one day."
Kent and the ladies gazed at the two dragons circling a dragon core in the air, and they could both feel the fury emanating from them.
One was a blue dragon made of ice, and the second was a red dragon made of fire. The energy coming from the half-blue and half-red core was something Kent could tell was the dragon’s energy.
"What is going on? Is Lilian going to be okay?" Elsa asked with a worried expression.

Though she and Lilian had become sisters, she still saw her as her daughter. Watching as her body was reduced to a core just after she added her blood to the True Name Token made her deeply concerned.
"She will be fine. You went through the same thing and came out just fine, so relax and just watch" Kent smiled and continued to watch.
An hour later, the dragons merged with the blue-red core. Kent, who was staring at the core, felt the True Name and the method of awakening appear in her mind, forcing a smile to her lips.
"The Fury of the Everlasting Flames and the Stillness of the Eternal Ice. A union born out of chaos and understanding. The rise of the Frostfire.
The awakening of a menace. The one who possesses the flame’s fury and the ice’s coldness. She has risen and is ready to take the mantle of the Dual Dragon Mage, the Frostfire Dragon Mage.
She is Aezrith Nivalis Ignis, the Eternal Frostfire Dragon.
Rise from the flames and freeze the heart of all. Rise, Aezrith Nivalis Ignis."
When Kent spoke those words, the place turned icy and scorching hot. The flame and the ice were burning like never before.

In fact, the sensation was something many wouldn’t truly understand, for ice and fire were now in union, and the feeling coming from it said it all. It is not something many would want to come into existence.
From up in the air, a blue-red dragon looked down upon the bugs on the floor and roared.
It circled the air briefly before returning to its original position.
Then it transformed, and a breathtaking beauty appeared. Everyone first noticed the colour of her eyes: one eye was blue, and the other was red.
But they are breathtaking.
She has long blue hair with strands of red in it, and her body has changed. She now has a red and blue dragon horn on her forehead.
Her skin is covered in shades of red and blue scales, making her appear both majestic and powerful.
Her body is an hourglass of seductiveness, and even her chest area has grown, giving her a presence that no man can look away from.
But after appearing like that for a moment, the horns disappeared, and she transformed again. This time, her eyes turned completely blue—both of them.
Then, instead of fire and ice qi emanating from her, only freezing cold ice came from her. Her eyes were blue, and her hair was also blue.
But that, too, lasted only a few seconds before she changed again. This time, her eyes turned red, and her hair also became red. That was her fourth form, and Kent, who was on the ground, smiled.
’Four forms, huh? Just what bloodline has she awakened?’ He scanned her and focused solely on her bloodline. When he saw it, a part of her smiled happily, as if she had met an old friend.
⟪Bloodline: Primordial Frostfire Dragon Lineage (25%)⟫
→ This bloodline descends from a legendary dragon known as Vaeltharion, the Twin-Breath Tyrant, who wielded both Primordial Frost and Eternal Flame—a nearly impossible combination.
→ The one who inherits this bloodline shall be called a Frostfire Dracovian, for she will have command over both ice and fire.
’Just 25%, and she can already have a full-on dragon form. I guess the moment I awaken my bloodline to 10%, I can also rise to a similar stage or close.’
Kent smiled.

Lilian stayed in the air for a few minutes before descending with an air of grace. She had taken on the form of Ice, meaning unlike Elsa, who can only maintain her sentinel form for a few hours a day, she can do so all day.
This also means that in her demi-dragon form, which is the union between fire and ice, she can only maintain it for a short while.
As for her dragon form, Kent knew that though she could take on her full dragon form, she would need to awaken more of her bloodline to maintain that transformation permanently.
She came right into Kent’s waiting arms and locked into a fierce kiss with her. During the kiss, a red and blue dragon tattoo appeared on Kent’s forehead for a moment before it disappeared.
However, in Kent’s vision, a message appeared, shocking him.
He had never heard of the legacy of the Frostfire Dracovian, but now, in his arms, was a beauty who commanded that bloodline.
Strangely, this beauty had just bestowed upon her something gods would kill for.

During the kiss, a red and blue dragon tattoo appeared on Kent’s forehead for a moment before it disappeared.
However, in Kent’s vision, a message appeared, shocking him.
He had never heard of the legacy of the Frostfire Dracovian, but now, in his arms, was a beauty who commanded that bloodline.
Strangely, this beauty had just bestowed upon her something gods would kill for.

chapters.title: Chapter 361: The Frostfire Dracovian, The Two Promises
paragraphs: "How are you feeling, Lil?" Elsa asked, holding her daughter’s hand.
"I am fine, Mom. More than fine. Look, I am now a dragon." She smiled, causing her sisters to smile as well. The beauty they knew had now become something else.
She had become stronger, for they could sense her energy, and she had become even more beautiful.
The body she had before had changed completely. The new her is a force and beauty that can shake the hearts of men.
"So, can you turn into a dragon anytime you want?" Mara asked with a curious expression.
"No, at least not yet. I am two races in one body. So, in a way, you can call me a hybrid."
"Care to explain?" she asked again.
"A part of my bloodline allows me to take on a dragon form, which is derived from ice and fire. But another part allows me to be this—this is like a human form.
So, in a way, I am a blend of the two. However, when I turn into my demi-dragon form, you could say I have balanced the two out, like how I can now balance both flame and ice."
"So, you’re saying your human side is more dominant?"
"I wouldn’t say dominant. It’s more a matter of convenience. Taking these two forms doesn’t require me to use my bloodline actively.
I can shift between ice and fire willingly. I can also turn into my hybrid form for eight hours every day if I want. But for my full dragon form, I can only maintain it for three hours a day.
But it’s enough because, in any of my forms, I can use my bloodline abilities."
The ladies nodded with smiles on their faces. They were not blind; they could tell she had indeed become different yet the same, and the aura emanating from her was one they all wanted to feel.
The fire was powerful, yet the ice was also freezing, as it should be. Lilian was now an Arch Mage, meaning she could cast up to Tier 7 spell circles.
And while that alone was fearsome, she had now become even more monstrous because of the bloodline abilities she had awakened.
Kent didn’t want to spend all the time going through them all, but after reading just a few, he could already see his woman rising to the peak with ice and fire.
As for what this means for the future, he will learn it when they meets the dragons.
After all, the legend of the Twin-Breath Tyrant was one known to many dragon races to this day. She was hated by many, for she was deemed an abomination of a dragon.
But that doesn’t mean the Frostfire Dragon, hated during the primordial era, didn’t have sympathizers.
She did, and right now, somewhere in the vast universe, millions are celebrating, for the Ignis star has appeared in the sky, meaning the legacy of the long-lost Frostfire Dragon has risen.
This time, she is not alone.
This time, she has a Sentinel as a sister and a Chaos Dragon as a husband. Her legacy is bound to take the universe by ice and fire.
"Congratulations on becoming you, Lil—or should I call you Ignis, or perhaps Nivalis? Of course, I could also call you Aezrith," Kent asked with a smile.
"Call me whatever name you deem fit. You have already invoked my true name, meaning you have supreme authority over me. That is already enough for me to know I will forever be bound to you.
As for my name, you can decide."
He smiled as she rubbed the dragon pressing against her legs.
"Then from now onwards, I will use all four names to refer to you. Lilian is your name, but Ignis, Aezrith, and Nivalis are also your names."
Lilian nodded, and her sisters smiled with her.
Kent then looked toward Selene, who knew she was next. Unity had a different arrangement that Kent hadn’t uncovered yet.
She needed a destiny token to awaken her true name. So Kent could only stare at her lovingly.
But as he looked at her, he could tell she was happy for her sister, who had become a beauty and a powerhouse.
The smile was genuine, and for a moment, Kent felt emotions he had never felt before just from looking at her.
It was like looking at someone who had done something selfless out of love. That smile gave him a sense of déjà vu for reasons he couldn’t yet understand.
’Just who are you, Unity, and why am I feeling this way?’ Kent thought to himself. He looked at her for a few more seconds before focusing back on Selene.
He retrieved the True Name Token, dropped Selene’s blood on it, added his own, and then activated the token, starting the second awakening of the day.
Selene was raised into the air, just like Lilian.
Meanwhile, far away in what one would call the core of the universe, a breathtaking beauty who seemed to be watching something amusing smiled.
The image of Kent looking at Unity appeared in front of her.
"So, you still don’t remember her, huh? I guess after going through many reincarnations, your memories will take a while to surface.
But she cannot wait for that long. She has already done enough for you and everyone, my dear Chaos. You promised her in two different lives, and now, that promise may be fulfilled.

The Archer girl who laid down her life so you could move on needs to wake up again. The stable girl who chose to become the sacrifice so her world and the one she loved could live on must be remembered."
She snapped her fingers, and an orb appeared. Her smile bloomed.
"Her name was Artemis, the one who was born to wield the bow. Her name was Love, for her true essence is love in its purest form.
You must fulfil your purpose, Chaos. She has slept for a very long time." The orb left her hand and travelled through the void until it stopped before the Quest Pool, where it fell in.
Kent, who didn’t know his life was about to go on a rollercoaster because of two promises he made years ago, could only stare at the awakening of yet another legendary figure happening in the air.
The lady at the core of the universe continued to watch with a smile on her face. This time, she was staring at Unity, who was smiling at the happenings in the air.
"I await your awakening, sworn sister. You still have a lot to teach me about love."

chapters.title: Chapter 362: Rebirth of Lunaris Astraea—the Moonlit Celestial Blade
paragraphs: She once severed the wings of the Abyssal Serpent, shattered the Black Obsidian Wall of the Nether Kings, and even defied the Celestial Sovereigns.
She once cut the firmament of the heavens and severed the fate line of an entire demonic race.
She once held the moon’s power in her hands, stared death in the face, and smiled, uttering these distinct words: "Death is afraid of my sword."
In the Age of Starfall, when the heavens wept, silver flames and fragments of the cosmos rained upon Zyrathis, a world of great prosperity and power.
Among these fragments was a celestial sword that descended from the sky and landed in the heart of Zyrathis.
Any mortal hands did not forge it, nor was it wielded by any living being—it was a blade of divine origin, birthed from the very essence of the moon and stars.
It came into being of its own accord, and not even the gods possessed what it took to wield it.
They called it Astraea’s Edge. A blade said to call upon the one worthy to wield it.
Her name was Ilyria Astraea, a warrior-priestess who wielded her weapon with love. She was a powerhouse who was one day called by the sword.
She was a guardian of the Lunar Sanctum, a temple built atop the mountain where the sword had fallen.
Ilyria was the first mortal to hear the blade’s whisper—a voice that spoke not in words but in sword intent, a call only a true swordsman could comprehend.
She reached out, and in that moment, her fate was sealed. The blade acknowledged her as its chosen one, but such recognition came at a cost.
Ilyria was no longer human—she became something more, a warrior bound by the celestial order, neither wholly mortal nor fully divine.
Her body was remade, her soul reforged, and with it, a new True Name was born.
"The one whose destiny was changed. The one who wields the celestial sword capable of cutting the firmament. The one who has the power to sever the lines of fate.
The one who is said to embody the essence of the moon and the stars." Kent smiled.
He looked at the silver sword in the sky and smiled.
"Rise, Lunaris Astraea—the Moonlit Celestial Blade. Rise, Lunaris Astraea, the Heavenly Ascender."
The sky shook, and intense sword intent filled the Harem Gate. Kent quickly sent the ladies away, for the presence that was descending was one that transcended the limits of mortals.
If they were to remain there for a few seconds, not even their bones would remain.
A celestial presence descended, taking the form of an elegant-looking silver sword bathed in something Kent recognized.
"Sword Will."
The Selene he knew had now become a sword, and she descended from the heavens, slowly merging with a smaller sword in the air.
Kent was both enlightened and suppressed by the presence of the Sword Will in the air. The two swords merged, and for a moment, everything came to a standstill.
Then, a handle grasped the sword from thin air and lifted it up. That was when Kent saw the whitish-silver-haired beauty clad in garment-like armour appear from thin air.
She raised the sword and slashed it down, cutting an opening into reality. She stepped in, and with that sudden movement, her presence vanished.
"What happened?" Kent asked, a little panicked.
⟪She will be back, Master; just give her a few minutes. This is all part of her awakening.⟫
Gaia answered, calming Kent instantly. He trusted his two assistants, so if Gaia said she was fine, he would believe her.
He began to wait, and four minutes later, like Gaia said, Reality was cut open again, and the beauty who had entered walked out, holding the silver sword once more.
She looked breathtaking.
’Though she didn’t become a succubus, damn, those features are even more alluring to me despite being covered in armour.’
Kent may be the biggest pervert in existence, for in that moment, instead of looking at the sword, he was appraising the body hovering in the air.
She looked down at Kent and smiled. "You are a pervert, you know that right?" Selene noticed his gaze and knew what he was doing, so she flew into his waiting arms.
When she was a few meters away, her armour vanished, and with her newly formed seductive body, she fell into his arms.
They kissed, and Kent, who couldn’t hold back, grabbed her ass and started kneading it while his lips found her nipples. For a few minutes, things got heated.
"How do you feel?" he asked after five minutes of kissing and sucking of nipples.
"I feel great. I not only became the best version of myself, but I now have a bloodline that links me to the sword, like I always wanted. This feeling is amazing," she said enthusiastically.
"Good to see you’re fine and happy."
"Are you kidding me? I’m more than happy. I now have the strength to protect you now." Selene puffed her chest out, making her round melons appear even more pronounced.
"Let’s not get ahead of ourselves. You still have the sword path I prepared for you to walk."
⟪Master, I think she’s speaking the truth. You remember the path she’s meant to walk, right?⟫ Gaia asked.
’Yes. It’s the Heaven’s Ascendence Sword Path,’ Kent replied.
⟪Yes. The thing is, I don’t know how it happened, but her awakening turned her into someone walking that path.
This means that now that she’s at the peak Sword Saint stage, she’ll instantly start her training at the Sword Saint level.
In other words, she’s now stronger than you and, as such, has what it takes to protect you. Just give up now, for the lady before you is no longer the Selene you knew.
She has become someone very powerful, and I am sure when you learn more about her lineage, you will fall in love with her all over again.
In fact, be quick and ascend to the higher worlds, where you will get access to materials that will inform you more about the kind of monsters you are creating...⟫
Kent looked at Selene, who was smiling.
"I guess I’ll hide under your skirt and let you protect me from my enemies," Kent said with a smile, then kissed her again.
"Let me bring your sisters back." Kent waved his hand, and the ladies reappeared.
"What happened?" Ingrid asked.
"Let’s just say you all came this close to dying when this one was awakening her bloodline," Kent said, gesturing toward Selene.
The ladies turned toward Selene.
"Sorry, I wasn’t in control," she muttered, but the ladies weren’t interested in that. They were more intrigued by her new body and appearance.
"I swear Kent has a hand in determining how we look. Just look at Elsa, Lilian, and now Selene. They each have a body to die for," Neomi said, and the ladies turned their attention to Kent.
"Don’t look at me like that. I had no hand in how you all look. But since I was fortunate enough to end up with big butts and elegant-looking fairies, who am I to complain?"
