chapters.title: Chapter 363: Birth of a Huntress
paragraphs: Long before the Eternal War of the Void, which decimated many worlds and shattered many stars, there was a city called Drakenshade.
It was a militarized fortress known for producing elite warriors. This city was the hub of what many called the Warrior Ascension Gate.
It was given that name simply because all who walked through its gates emerged as warriors capable of facing the greatest obstacles.
It was the city of warriors.
Her name was Vael.
She was the daughter of a dignified knight, Freya, and an accomplished demon hunter, Erik.

Vael was just like her parents—dedicated and disciplined. Under the guidance of her parents, she trained from a young age. By the time she turned 15, she was crowned one of the best spear maidens in Drakenshade.
Many praised her; many sought to bring her into their families as a future bride for their heirs.
However, despite her talent, she always felt different. She could see things others couldn’t—distortions in space, flickers of darkness in the air, and shadows that seemed to whisper her name.
This strangeness plagued her for years until she turned 20.
One fateful night, during a monster subjugation mission, Vael and her squad were sent to hunt a rare, abyss-born creature—a Void Wraith.
These creatures were considered remnants of a long-dead race, existing only in legend.
However, something awakened within her as soon as Vael gazed upon the Wraith with her Void Eyes.
It was as if everything in that moment made sense when her gaze fell on the creature.
Instead of attacking, the Wraith bowed before her. Then, with a whisper only she could hear, it said:
"The last has returned. The Hollow Star watches."
Before she could react, black tendrils shot out from the wraith and branded her body with Abyssal Marks, a sign of her Voidling heritage awakening.
But this wasn’t an awakening that was welcomed. Everyone rejected her When she started becoming who she was meant to be. Everyone, except her father, tried to kill her.
Those branded by the Mark of the Abyss are deemed tainted, and as such, they must be subjugated before they become uncontrollable.
But with her father sacrificing his life, she managed to escape.
Years later, when the creatures of the Void came, and the humans and other civilizations were helpless, Dar’Vhalar, the Abyssborne, appeared, riding on a Void Hound.
Following her and obeying her commands were the Voidlings, who, while hated by all, were actually the guardians meant to protect the universe from the creatures of the Void.

History has it that for 26 days, the Voidlings fought down to the last man. And when everything was in dire straits, Dar’Vhalar, the Void Reaver, made the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the last Voidling to lay down her life so the universe could live on.
Her name was lost over the years, but her legend still remains. And now, she is awakened again.

Kent looked up in the air, watching as a figure who once shook the battlefields, led the Voidlings in battle, and sacrificed her life alongside her brothers and sisters so life could continue was being reborn.
"Her name was lost, but her legend remains. They called her the Tainted, the Reject, the Abomination.
Yet, when the Hollows called, she answered and became who she was meant to be. All spoke her name, and her legend became an inspiration to all.
The echoes of the Void sang her glory and foretold that she would awaken again. They promised she would return to grace the battlefield once more.
Her name was Dar’Vhalar, and her name would be Dar’Vhalar again. Rise, daughter of a hunter, for your destiny is about to begin.
Rise, Dar’Vhalar, the Abyssborne Huntress."
"Come to the Hollow Star, child of the abyss."
The heavens shook as a brown-skinned lady with dark-shaded eyes, who needed no introduction to know she was a huntress, raised her hands and snapped her fingers.
The void cracked, and from within its maw, a black spear shot from the void, landing in her firm grip. The void closed the next second, leaving only the beauty hovering in the air.
She has short, dark hair. Her body is covered in black leather armour, which does a good job of accentuating her features.
She bears the mark of the void on her forehead, showing the Void has accepted her as its own.
However, beyond her appearance, she exudes the aura of a warrior. The kind of presence only those who have killed thousands, or perhaps millions, could exude.
Standing with the ladies, Kent could tell every last one of them was scared.
And they should be, for the true name their sister has awakened was one that once belonged to a huntress, a real predator who has killed many.
She traversed the void to hunt down abominations, slaughtering countless of them. Such a person will have a presence that makes anyone fear her.
⟪The master should give her the bloodline now, for she has awakened it, but she doesn’t have much control over it.⟫
Gaia said to Kent, making the dragon nod. He flew toward Ingrid, who was looking at her sisters with the gaze of a huntress.
"You have become a menace, dear. Maybe you should stop scaring them now. Some might faint if those eyes don’t stop staring at them," Kent said, and Ingrid smiled. Her eyes were now completely dark.
"I was just messing with them," Ingrid blinked, and her dark eyes turned brown, matching her skin colour.
Her armour also vanished, revealing a beautiful body now covered with a large hound tattoo. Kent raised his brows, seeing such an elegant tattoo.
"That is my mount, but until I awaken 20% of my bloodline, it can only appear as a tattoo on my body," Ingrid explained, seeing Kent staring at it.
"It’s beautiful. It matches your skin tone, and damn, you just have to pack the assets on both your chest and backside."

sentences.text: Long before the Eternal War of the Void, which decimated many worlds and shattered many stars, there was a city called Drakenshade.
It was a militarized fortress known for producing elite warriors.
This city was the hub of what many called the Warrior Ascension Gate.
It was given that name simply because all who walked through its gates emerged as warriors capable of facing the greatest obstacles.
It was the city of warriors.
Her name was Vael.
She was the daughter of a dignified knight, Freya, and an accomplished demon hunter, Erik.
Vael was just like her parents—dedicated and disciplined.
Under the guidance of her parents, she trained from a young age.
By the time she turned 15, she was crowned one of the best spear maidens in Drakenshade.
Many praised her; many sought to bring her into their families as a future bride for their heirs.
However, despite her talent, she always felt different.
She could see things others couldn’t—distortions in space, flickers of darkness in the air, and shadows that seemed to whisper her name.
This strangeness plagued her for years until she turned 20.
One fateful night, during a monster subjugation mission, Vael and her squad were sent to hunt a rare, abyss-born creature—a Void Wraith.
These creatures were considered remnants of a long-dead race, existing only in legend.
However, something awakened within her as soon as Vael gazed upon the Wraith with her Void Eyes.
It was as if everything in that moment made sense when her gaze fell on the creature.
Instead of attacking, the Wraith bowed before her.
Then, with a whisper only she could hear, it said:
"The last has returned.
The Hollow Star watches."
Before she could react, black tendrils shot out from the wraith and branded her body with Abyssal Marks, a sign of her Voidling heritage awakening.
But this wasn’t an awakening that was welcomed.
Everyone rejected her When she started becoming who she was meant to be.
Everyone, except her father, tried to kill her.
Those branded by the Mark of the Abyss are deemed tainted, and as such, they must be subjugated before they become uncontrollable.
But with her father sacrificing his life, she managed to escape.
Years later, when the creatures of the Void came, and the humans and other civilizations were helpless, Dar’Vhalar, the Abyssborne, appeared, riding on a Void Hound.
Following her and obeying her commands were the Voidlings, who, while hated by all, were actually the guardians meant to protect the universe from the creatures of the Void.
History has it that for 26 days, the Voidlings fought down to the last man.
And when everything was in dire straits, Dar’Vhalar, the Void Reaver, made the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the last Voidling to lay down her life so the universe could live on.
Her name was lost over the years, but her legend still remains.
And now, she is awakened again.

Kent looked up in the air, watching as a figure who once shook the battlefields, led the Voidlings in battle, and sacrificed her life alongside her brothers and sisters so life could continue was being reborn.
"Her name was lost, but her legend remains.
They called her the Tainted, the Reject, the Abomination.
Yet, when the Hollows called, she answered and became who she was meant to be.
All spoke her name, and her legend became an inspiration to all.
The echoes of the Void sang her glory and foretold that she would awaken again.
They promised she would return to grace the battlefield once more.
Her name was Dar’Vhalar, and her name would be Dar’Vhalar again.
Rise, daughter of a hunter, for your destiny is about to begin.
Rise, Dar’Vhalar, the Abyssborne Huntress."
"Come to the Hollow Star, child of the abyss."
The heavens shook as a brown-skinned lady with dark-shaded eyes, who needed no introduction to know she was a huntress, raised her hands and snapped her fingers.
The void cracked, and from within its maw, a black spear shot from the void, landing in her firm grip.
The void closed the next second, leaving only the beauty hovering in the air.
She has short, dark hair.
Her body is covered in black leather armour, which does a good job of accentuating her features.
She bears the mark of the void on her forehead, showing the Void has accepted her as its own.
However, beyond her appearance, she exudes the aura of a warrior.
The kind of presence only those who have killed thousands, or perhaps millions, could exude.
Standing with the ladies, Kent could tell every last one of them was scared.

She traversed the void to hunt down abominations, slaughtering countless of them.

"You have become a menace, dear.

paragraphs: "How long is it going to take?" Selene asked, watching the huntress sit with her eyes closed as she began to absorb the Voidling bloodline.
"Probably a week," Kent replied, causing the ladies to smile.
"Then what do you propose we do while we wait for her?" Selene already had plans in mind before asking the first question.
"Why don’t I take you, Lilian, and Elsa to your training towers? That will be a good way to spend the week while we wait for Ingrid," Kent smirked, saying that.
"You..." Selene pouted.
"What, don’t you want to see what I have prepared for you?" Kent asked.
"That can wait. We want to spend the week doing what you love," she smiled, trying to seduce the dragon, but Kent was in the mood for some teasing.
"I like to train with the sword, so why don’t we spar instead?"
His reply earned him a few eye rolls, but the next second, his body stiffened when a Tier 7 spell circle appeared beneath him, and chains made of ice grabbed hold of his leg.
Lilian smiled at him, causing Kent to smirk and gently tap the ice, forcing it to melt off his leg. This made Lilian raise an eyebrow.
"How did you do that? I could swear that was a Tier 7 spell circle that can easily trap a Root Transcendent.
How did you neutralize it?" she asked. Though she wasn’t against her man, she wanted to understand how he casually neutralised her attack.
"That is a secret," Kent smiled and vanished. Right when he did, a second Selene appeared out of thin air with the intent of seizing him.
"Too slow, my love," Kent appeared beside Mara and gently landed a slap on her naked butt, causing it to jiggle. The gate master blushed.
"How did you do that?" This time, it was Selene who asked.
"A secret," Kent replied, flashing the same smile at the sword ascender, who held a look of mischief in her eyes.
"Surround him!" she shouted, and her sisters jumped into action. None pulled their weapons, but they were ready to handle the brat who didn’t want to give them what they were after.
Kent, who felt his body getting restricted, smiled.
’Fighting naked beauties isn’t something I saw coming. But now that it’s about to happen...’ His smile bloomed as he vanished again and appeared beside Camilla.
Pah.
A gentle slap landed on her ass, too, causing the ladies to giggle. Yet, they still lunged into action and began chasing after him, who chose to run away.
Three minutes later, they caught him, stripped him naked, and started sucking his divine rod. Since they wanted to have another wonderful night with him, none held back.
They paired up and took turns pleasuring him. They only suck him for the next time they get more intimate will be like having their second first time again.
Kent, who could only let them have their way with his body, lay there with a smile on his face as they did as they pleased.
After they had their fill, they lay in bed with him. Kent used the time to go through their information.
It took him a few hours, but after going through everything, he began to suspect that his ladies were not ordinary people.
The changes that had happened to them could only have been dormant and were only awakened using the True Name token.
In fact, he could tell the True Names once belonged to them—or perhaps, a version of them.
This got him thinking.
If the True Names were people who once lived, then did that mean these people were now the ladies sleeping beside him?
He didn’t want to jinx it, but a feeling of longing washed over him whenever he looked at them.
It was as if he was longing for something, and now that they had started to become who they were meant to be, he seemed to think this longing was the True Names waiting to be invoked.
Elsa is now an Aether Warden with the strength to wield soul energy. She is immune to soul attacks and can harness the power of souls to do her bidding.
She also has the power to harness the soul Aether to manage the souls of others.
Then there is Lilian, who has become both a dual elemental and a dragon, capable of breaking the balance of civilizations.
Selene is also there, with complete control over lunar energy. She is literally one with the moon. And now, there is Ingrid, who, so far, could be considered the most feared lady in his harem.
’Just what did I do to get this lucky? Kent said to himself, watching the beauties by his side.
From afar, the lady sitting at the core of the universe smiled.
"You made a lot of sacrifices, Chaos. You are selfless and caring, and as such, you now have the best of the best. But while you are meant to have the best, you are not done yet.
You must grow fast, for the danger coming is one you alone cannot handle. So grow alongside them, and one day, when it all turns bleak, you can be at peace knowing you are not alone."
The smile on her face was that of someone happy and proud.
If Kent were to see it, he would have already made up his mind to tap that ass. But he is still too weak to reach her.
She is currently at a place Kent cannot reach and can’t come to him. So, for now, she can only watch and be happy for him.
His home is now with his ladies, but when the time comes for him to go home, he will take the beauties with him.
After an entire week of lovemaking and waiting, Ingrid finally finished absorbing the Voidling bloodline, stabilizing her entire bloodline and even awakening 25% of it.
The moment she achieved that, the tattoo on her body came to life, and a dark hound—more majestic than terrifying, as a hound should be—appeared.
It was imposing, and from its presence, they all recognized its rank, which shocked them.
The hound was at the Root Transcendent stage, while Ingrid, just like Selene, became a Root Transcendent warrior after the awakening.
This made Kent smile, for he knew he had succeeded in being the most amazing husband in the universe.
Even Lilian moved straight to the peak of the Root Great Sage stage. Kent could only smile at the cheat of a tower he managed to inherit.
The ladies could save the two women currently being held against their will even if he chose not to be part of it.
But there can never be too much of something, for since he has the means, he can only use it to help his ladies, who are now becoming some of the strongest beings in the world.
When Ingrid was done, her master was next.
The ritual was performed, and when the sky turned crimson, the Dragon and his women welcomed a figure who once struck fear into her enemies’ hearts.
They called her by many names, but she was known mostly by a name that, to this day, still held weight.
Rakshasa, the War Princess.

chapters.title: Chapter 365: The Princess of War (1)
paragraphs: Vashrakar, the city of the strong.
That was the city where the War Princess was born. Her father was nonexistent. Her mother was a soldier blessed with the speed of an eagle.
She was called the Iron Fang Eagle, for her presence was like the passing wind in battle. She was the bringer of death to the battlefield.
Her mother had just led her soldiers to victory the day Shara was born. They said during the battle, her water broke, but until the last soldier was stabbed through the heart, she held back.
Shara was a war child, for she was born in war.
They called her the War Child, Daughter of battle.
She picked up her first weapon when she was seven and took her first life when she was nine.
That day, it was kill or be killed, for when her mother was betrayed and injured in battle, she carried her using all her strength. On the run, she had to make a bold choice.
Her mother watched her vomit her intestines out after she killed her first human.
But the next day, she had to kill three more. Within a week, she killed her first ten humans and started liking it.
The irony.
Many mothers become proud of their daughters when they get married into good families or when they come of age and manage to enter sects that teach good manners.
But to Zhara, she saw her daughter drive her spear through the heart of a fellow human, and at that moment, she knew she had given birth to a child of her own image.
She became happy.
She was proud of her daughter.
So she made the ultimate sacrifice as a good mother, and for years, she and her war child trained and killed their fair share.
By the time Shara turned eighteen, she had killed thousands.
Then, her mother became sick and was dying.
However, in her last moments, she gave Shara the token of their lineage. For a long time before her birth, the Rak’Vhara race had dominated worlds and starfields.
The token led her back to her lineage, where she entered the Trial of the Awakening. She was thrust into a world of torment with 10,000 others.
365 days later, only she walked out, and since that day, she began to walk the path of the Rak’Vhara. She became who they called the Lover of Wars.
She wielded a spear that changed from black to red, for the blood of her enemies altered its colour. They called her the Reaper’s Advocate.
The Mother of Killers.
The Warbringer.
The Harbinger of Death.
Then, her legend came to an end. Like every legendary tale, Shara made the ultimate sacrifice when she chose to march into battle and never returned.
Her legend was written in the blood of her victims.
They called her Shara, but the universe deemed her fit to become a martyr in her last moments, so she was named Rakshasa, the Warbringer.
The legends speak of her return. They say the day she awakens, all battlefields will fall silent for a moment, for the one whose name was used to name wars will be reborn.
On millions of battlefields raging on across the universe, they all became still for a few moments.
Kent was staring at the red sky, and for a moment, his mind was pulled back to a realm he hadn’t been to before. When he returned, a four-armed weapon spirit was hovering before him.

"My lord, I advise you to evacuate your ladies from here. The master is awakening, and while it will be a sight to behold, the awakening of Rakshasa is not something mere mortals can comprehend," said the weapon spirit Neomi had brought back from the realm of enlightenment.
Kent needed no second reminder to understand the truth in her words. The feeling in the air was indeed abnormal.
"Ladies, go for now. Gaia will ensure you can watch it." They nodded, and Kent moved them to the Body Tower.
A screen appeared before them and they began to watch the events happening inside the Harem tower.
"Now what?" Kent asked.
"The Lord might want to draw his weapon," the weapon spirit said. Before she could finish, a spear appeared in front of Kent.
From the moment Neomi ascended into the air, a red cloud enveloped her, preventing anyone from seeing what was happening. So when the spear came, Kent was caught off-guard.
But he reacted quickly and blocked it.
"What in the hell?" Kent was dumbfounded when he felt his body stiffen right after deflecting the spear.
He quickly used the Rule Breaker skill he received from Selene, cancelling the effect that had trapped him.
He was quick enough, so the attack meant to take his life was parried away. But the moment he parried that attack, the mist cleared.
That was when the face of his attacker appeared, and it wasn’t a friendly face.
The lady was clad in spiked armour made from what appeared to be leather, yet it looked and felt metallic. The spear in her hands was red, and the look in her deep red eyes was anything but friendly.
"Those are the eyes of a killer," Kent thought. For some reason, he recognized that look, and his heart shook.
"Lady, what the hell is going on?" Kent turned to the four-armed spirit hovering in the air, watching the battle as if it didn’t concern her.
"Rakshasa was a child of war. She died in war, and now that she is awakening, she craves war.
Your job is to ensure she doesn’t succumb to her bloodlust. In other words, you must wake her up before she slips into a state she can never return from."
"I see," Kent said. He didn’t need to be told twice. The lady in the air is his woman. Failing her was the last thing he wanted.
He knew what the four-armed spirit said was plausible, so he sighed, and with a thought, his clothes transformed into form-fitting battle armour made from metallic cotton.
The armour’s extra abilities allowed it to take on any appearance and form he could imagine, so he harnessed its power.
Then, his eyes turned dark gold as two dragon horns emerged from his forehead. The claws on his right hand extended and melded with his sword.
His skin was soon covered in dark gold scales. The battle he was about to fight required him to be at his peak.
The lady before him exuded a presence that Kent recognized as that of a menace. He looked up, and a smirk appeared on his lips.
"Hello there, my love. Forgive me for what I am about to do, but this is for your own good."
His smile widened, and then, with a movement of his chest and shoulders, two pairs of dragon wings burst from his back as he took to the air.

His skin was soon covered in dark gold scales.
The battle he was about to fight required him to be at his peak.
The lady before him exuded a presence that Kent recognized as that of a menace.
He looked up, and a smirk appeared on his lips.
"Hello there, my love.
Forgive me for what I am about to do, but this is for your own good."
His smile widened, and then, with a movement of his chest and shoulders, two pairs of dragon wings burst from his back as he took to the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 366: The Princess of War (2)
paragraphs: Boom
A sword and spear collided in the air, creating a powerful shockwave that spread far and wide.
Kent was in the air with his dragon wings spread behind him allowing him to move faster. The moment his bloodline moved from 5% to 8%, he sensed something new awakened within him.
Of course, since it wasn’t something he was planning on using at the moment, he instead focused on awakening the bloodline of his women.
However, things are different now.
The wife he was awakening was now stronger and deadlier than the one he knew before the awakening ritual began.
Kent still hasn’t received her true name nor a way to invoke it, so this means the one he was fighting was like the true name she was about to receive.
This also means before Neomi would receive her true name, Kent must defeat the true name.
But the problem is, the person up in the air is first, faster than him. Second, stronger than him in all regards, and lastly, more experience and deadlier than him.
This means Kent is fighting against an odd; he cannot easily defend himself from getting killed. Talk less about defeating her.
Luckily, he has something he can only thank his ladies for.
’Gaia, kindly divide the points I have between my strength and speed.’ Kent gave the order as he evaded a spear thrust that was aimed at his neck.
The lady in the air only attacks to kill.
⟪That will be 12,000 points for each.⟫
Kent felt his strength and speed soar as he matched Neomi’s speed and strength. Of course, he didn’t know if that was her top speed, but she was fast enough to overwhelm any Root Great Sage.
"Rapid Slash!"
Kent unleashed all 450 sword arcs, aiming to force her back.
However, the next second, Neomi took a circular swing, and a gush of wind as sharp as a razor formed around her, cutting the sword arcs into countless pieces.
’Damn, she neutralized my attack just like that.’ Kent was blown away.
But he didn’t dwell on it, as the next second, hundreds of small portals opened up in the air, and razor-sharp spears began raining down from them.
The spears rained down, and Kent had to unleash his sword intent, filling the air with sword qi. The spears were blocked by the field he created; however, a few passed through it.
He unleashed the True Despair sword strike skill, decimating them all.
When the last spear was destroyed, Kent found himself in a world of wind as a powerful force tossed his body around.
He didn’t know when it happened or realized it could be this intense.
’My eyes are really being opened to things,’ he thought, smiling despite his harrowing situation. The wind was something infused with spear qi.
This made him gain something akin to clarity.
The wind was overwhelming, but thanks to his wings, he stabilised himself just in time to see Neomi raise her spear.
"Rakshasa," she muttered coldly.
In an instant, Kent felt his armour cut into from all sides.
"What in the name of..." Kent quickly noticed the change, but before he could find a counter, a figure rose from behind Neomi, towering 12 meters into the air.
It had six arms, and from the moment it appeared, Kent knew he was no match for her. In fact, from the moment that word—or perhaps a name—was uttered, he sensed it.
That name held more power than he could comprehend at his current level. It was like staring at the face of death.
⟪Master must be careful. That is the manifestation of a spear intent. The attacks from it will be very dangerous.⟫
Just as Gaia spoke those words, Neomi raised her spear again and pointed it at Kent, muttering a word that made Kent narrow his eyes.
He closed his eyes and began channelling his energy into his sword.
"Zero Defense Annihilation."
The manifestation behind Neomi clapped two hands together and then snapped them open, instantly forcing a 6-meter-long spear made of spear qi to shoot toward Kent.
Kent stood there with his eyes closed, his sword bathed in sword qi, and the spear closed like a bullet. However, he just stood there, channelling his energy into his sword.
He remained still for a few minutes, but then he moved just as the spear came within a meter of him.
He unleashed dozens of sword attacks in rapid succession, creating intense and lethal sword lights, cutting the spear into many pieces.
Then he moved further, clashing with Neomi and forcing the manifestation to disappear.
But that wasn’t all. Kent raised his sword and took a vertical swing, unleashing a sword arc at the lady, whose eyes were burning more intensely.

"It’s working, my lord. The hungrier she gets, the better," the four-armed lady said to Kent, who could only smile as he battled the woman who, from the start until now, had only tried to attack and go for the kill.

Kent was making sure he didn’t accidentally kill her while she was doing her best to kill him. It was like that situation where no matter what, you have to support your wife, or else she will run with 50% of your wealth.
"Spear of the Wild!" A faint red spear appeared in the air and shot toward Kent.
"True Despair Sword Strike!" He also unleashed his skill, creating a shockwave filled with mist in the air.
Kent vanished into the mist, and a second later, he unleashed the full form of the [Rapid Slash] skill, forcing Neomi, who was caught off-guard, to crash onto the ground.
"Doom Shard!"
Kent commanded as pointed shards made of a black diamond shot from the ground, stabbing into the legs of the lady, who still held the expression of a warrior in her eyes despite the injuries.
"Lightning Slash!" Kent channelled his lightning energy into the sword and unleashed it, but Neomi simply used her spear to block it.
But that was what he aimed for. Kent appeared in front of the lady, whose body was being plague with lightning.
However, right as Kent appeared before her, a hand grabbed him from behind.
The moment he turned, he came face to face with another copy of Neomi—but this copy had six arms. The first four arms grabbed him while the other two raised spears aimed at his neck.
Kent smirked, for he knew the winner had been determined.
"We’ll fight again later, dear," he said.
The two spears stabbed at him, but just as they were an inch from his neck, his body vanished.
Then, from behind Neomi, a split body appeared. "This is going to hurt."
He landed a powerful kick to the back of her head, knocking her out cold. At the same moment, a true name appeared in his mind, and he began to recite it.

chapters.title: Chapter 367: Rakshasa Awakening
paragraphs: The sky remained red, and the body of the lady Kent had just defeated rose into the air. This time, the energy emanating from her was one of blood and death.
’Just what True Name can be this menacing?’ Kent wondered. He had now received the true name and the words to speak, but the words felt cold and heavy on his tongue.
⟪Master must invoke her true name, as the process has begun and cannot be delayed.⟫
Kent nodded and then stepped into character.
"Blood-soaked battlefields are her playground. Her hobby is to kill. Her vacation is to march onto the battlefield with her spear in a firm grip.
Blood rains when she smiles, and her enemies succumb when she looks at them. She goes by many names.
The dragons call her Blood Monarch, for her nature is that of blood.
The elves call her the Bane of Peace, for she is not peaceful.
The dwarves call her the Bringer of Disaster, for she is a menace on the battlefield.
However, she is known by only one name. The name of Rakshasa, the War Princess. The name signifies war. A child born in battle, the harbinger of death. The one who descended from peace into chaos."
Kent took a deep breath.
"Blood remembers. Battle calls. The Rakshasa rises once more. Rise, Warrior Princess. Rise, Vekshara, the Scarlet Fang."
Rumble!
The heavens shook as the blood-red sky cracked open, and a wave of red energy filled with the feeling of dread and chaos descended, bathing Neomi’s body.
⟪Blood Energy, huh? Master, I believe you have finally found someone who will always bring you trouble.⟫
’I know, Gaia. When I fought her, I could tell her nature is that of battle,’ Kent smiled.
’I can already see her attacking all those who will say something bad about me or try to come looking for trouble with me.’
⟪You should visit Goddess Vexthra. Maybe she can find something on the Rakshasa for you.⟫ Gaia suggested, but Kent smiled and looked at the four-armed spear spirit in the air.
Noticing his gaze, she turned toward him.
"You know about Rakshasa, right? Why don’t you tell me what you can recall? Every small detail will be fine."
"Rakshasa wasn’t just a name; it was a symbol. A symbol of war. The legend of Rakshasa can be told from different angles. The dragons have a different legend, and the elves also have their own.
However, from the legend I know, Rakshasa was a child born into battle and grew up in battle. She was a killer, someone who didn’t shy away from blood.
She is a menace, for she is the incarnation of slaughter.
Legend has it that during the Calamity Wars, when the creatures of the Grey Realm invaded, the alliance of 20 different races stood aside as the Princess of War slaughtered every last creature.
They called her the War Ender, for it was said that when she appeared in battle, the side she picked was destined to win.
They called her the Daughter of Death, for it was said that in all of history, she could be counted among the few who had sent many souls to the underworld."
The four-armed lady kept speaking, and from all she was saying, Kent could tell that the lady he had added to his harem, the genius sword saintess he fell in love with, was a menace to society.
’Damn, how hot can one be?’ He could already imagine how hot she would look when drenched in blood and slaughtering left and right.
Strangely, he wanted to see that sight, for a part of him was very happy she was becoming a Rakshasa.
Just as his heart calmed and his feelings deepened when he awakened the true names of his other ladies, he could already feel the same toward Neomi.
He was happy despite her awakening to such a true name.
"You should be happy, my Lord. Rakshasa is someone worth having as an ally. But be ready, for she is a child of battle, so she cannot leave the battlefield."
Kent nodded.
’The dungeons will come in handy from now onwards.’
The awakening process went on for five whole days.

However, when it ended, the colour in the air vanished, replaced by black and white. Kent’s face turned pale, but because there was no colour in the air, nobody could tell the pressure bearing down on him.
The pressure falling down on him is just too much.
Then, the space cracked, and a lady walked out.
She held a spear in her hand, and from the armour she was wearing, one could say she was straight from the battleground.
There were scratch marks on it, and it was dyed red, which, in this context, was the blood of her opponents. She tied her hair in a black ponytail, and hovering behind her was a circular cosmic ring.
"She rose from the ashes of battle, and she will grace the battlefield again with her fury. All hail Rakshasa, the War Princess."
From the side, the four-armed lady bowed and then turned into an orb that shot forth and entered the spear in Neomi’s grip.
Kent was in no position to move or say anything, for at that moment, if the lady tried to kill him, she would succeed.
His body was locked down, and no matter what, he couldn’t break free.
He could only watch as she moved from the crack and stopped when she was two meters from him.
The look in her eyes was dangerous, but because there was no vibrant colour in the air, Kent could only see black shades within them.
The only saving grace was she wasn’t moving for the kill.
She moved a little closer, and a smile appeared on her lips when she was in front of Kent. She then snapped her fingers, and the crack closed, bringing colour back.
Kent’s body was let go, and Neomi, who was right in front of him, blinked. At once, her armour, spear, and warlike appearance vanished.
In her place stood a damsel to die for. She was impeccable in her body and her beauty, and Kent, who wanted to know how she had restrained him, immediately forgot about that question.
Instead, he stared into her beautiful red eyes, and for a moment, he could envision the two of them engaged in a fierce, passionate battle in the bedroom.
"You have become a demoness," Kent said, smiling.
"A demoness for you, my love. From today onward, I will be your war general, for that is who I am and who I am meant to be."
Kent pulled her closer until her breasts were pressed against his chest.
"There will be many battles to fight, my love... many battles to be fought." He locked onto her lips, and for the next five minutes, they could only kiss and kiss and keep kissing.
This was a happy moment for both of them. The two are meant for each other.
One was a Primordial Chaos Dragon... the bringer of chaos.
And the other was Rakshasa, the War Princess.
When chaos and war become one, not even the universe cannot predict what will happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 368: The Three Forms of Rakshara
paragraphs: "This is just too much for someone like me to comprehend," Mara said, looking at the four ladies who had become the best versions of themselves and, in doing so, had become different people altogether.
"Sometimes you just have to accept what is and watch as what is meant to be unfolds," Kent smiled, watching the ladies admire the changes Neomi had undergone.
Just like the three before her, she had also become a beauty. However, there was something about her that seemed to startle them all.
Neomi had not only become a beauty with dark hair and striking facial features, but she had also taken on an air of slaughter that only those who had killed thousands could possess.
She had three forms that even Kent had a hard time wrapping his mind around them.
In her first form, she retained her dark hair and tan complexion. In that form, she appeared as the most harmless person anyone could ever meet.
However, Kent and the ladies couldn’t help but fear the look in her eyes despite her seemingly harmless demeanour.
It was like a tiger that had chosen to cloak itself in a sheep’s skin.
But that was the form she would take when going out or spending time with her sisters. In that form, she is just Neomi...
She called her second form Vak’Shara. It was that of a warrior whose armour was drenched in blood. In fact, calling her a warrior was an understatement—in that form, she was a killer born of blood.
Essentially, she was the embodiment of slaughter.
From the description Kent read, in that form—which she could maintain for only an hour a day—all her senses would be heightened, and aside from her allies, anything she faced would die.
The more she killed, the stronger she became.
The more blood-soaked her armour and body, the more lethal she became.

Had Kent been aware of the true history of Rakshasa, he would have recognized that form, for it was the form she used to enter the trial of awakening, where 10,000 natural-born killers were pitted against each other, with the endgame being that only one would walk out alive.
Shara entered that trial when her mother died, and she walked out a killer who had to slay 6,790 people to survive.
Her skills are for killing, and her aspects are for killing.
Then there is her Rakshara form, where she becomes a warrior princess born for war. In this form, she is clad in red and black armour and wields a red spear.
In that form, she bears the Mark of War on her forehead and the tattoo of battle on her face. Her short hair and athletic build in that form made the blood of her sisters run cold.
She can maintain that for three hours every day. She only awakened 25% of her bloodline.
The three forms of Rakshara are Prey, Slaughter, and Warrior. But even though she is prey, the predator lies hidden behind her eyes.
"Moments like this make me wonder where you came from and where you are going, Kent," Neomi asked, looking fondly at Kent, who was getting his divine rod serviced by a Void Reaver.
Ingrid may have become a dangerous warrior, but when it came to her main, she was as tame as a cat.
"I came from the unknown, ladies, and I am rising to kill a god, for that is the mission I will accomplish in less than a century," Kent smiled.
"You want to kill a god?" Camilla raised an eyebrow.
"Indeed, my love. I rose from the dead to kill a god, and I will kill him regardless of who he is or what authority he holds." The ladies turned and looked at him.
"You’ll be taking us with you, right?" Neomi asked, already pumped for a battle of that magnitude.
"Of course. Killing a god is not one man’s job, after all," Kent smiled. Though he will be killing a god, Vexthra still hasn’t told him why she wants the God of Alchemy dead.
But he doesn’t really care. Vexthra is his wife, and as such, whatever she wants will be given to her—even if it involves killing a god.
"You ladies should stop being petty and let Kent awaken your True Names," Ingrid, who had had her fill of the dragon juice, said to Mara, Camilla, and Val.
They knew Unity wasn’t getting her True Name yet because she had a different arrangement.
Alina also isn’t getting the chance to break away from her master, who has much more to ask about Kent than focusing on managing her auction house and business empire.
This means they will have to pause the awakening here for now, mainly because the three who have yet to join the harem are being petty.

"If we’re being petty, then what about you all who wanted to have a second ’first time’ with Kent again? Don’t you think something like that would also be welcome by us too?" Val stuck out her tongue, teasing the ladies.
"Your loss," Selene said, though she knew she would have done the same thing if she were in their place.
"No need to look down on us, sisters. The moment we’re done with the rescue mission, this brat won’t have any more excuses to deny us anymore," Mara said, and the ladies nodded.
"Then what’s next?" Selene asked.
"The mission will be in three days’ time, meaning you all have 72 days to get familiar with your new abilities and bodies.
So, I will send you to the training towers I made for each of you. You can train there for the next 72 days while I work outside.
The mission is already a success, but we should put in all of it, for it’s for the lives of two beautiful ladies—and you all know how much I value the lives of beauties."

The second Undead will be arriving in a few hours’ time, meaning he must prepare for what is coming and the mission that will happen right after her creation is complete.

sentences.text: "This is just too much for someone like me to comprehend," Mara said, looking at the four ladies who had become the best versions of themselves and, in doing so, had become different people altogether.
"Sometimes you just have to accept what is and watch as what is meant to be unfolds," Kent smiled, watching the ladies admire the changes Neomi had undergone.
Just like the three before her, she had also become a beauty.
However, there was something about her that seemed to startle them all.
Neomi had not only become a beauty with dark hair and striking facial features, but she had also taken on an air of slaughter that only those who had killed thousands could possess.
She had three forms that even Kent had a hard time wrapping his mind around them.
In her first form, she retained her dark hair and tan complexion.
In that form, she appeared as the most harmless person anyone could ever meet.
However, Kent and the ladies couldn’t help but fear the look in her eyes despite her seemingly harmless demeanour.
It was like a tiger that had chosen to cloak itself in a sheep’s skin.
But that was the form she would take when going out or spending time with her sisters.
In that form, she is just Neomi...
She called her second form Vak’Shara.
It was that of a warrior whose armour was drenched in blood.
In fact, calling her a warrior was an understatement—in that form, she was a killer born of blood.
Essentially, she was the embodiment of slaughter.
From the description Kent read, in that form—which she could maintain for only an hour a day—all her senses would be heightened, and aside from her allies, anything she faced would die.
The more she killed, the stronger she became.
The more blood-soaked her armour and body, the more lethal she became.

Had Kent been aware of the true history of Rakshasa, he would have recognized that form, for it was the form she used to enter the trial of awakening, where 10,000 natural-born killers were pitted against each other, with the endgame being that only one would walk out alive.
Shara entered that trial when her mother died, and she walked out a killer who had to slay 6,790 people to survive.
Her skills are for killing, and her aspects are for killing.
Then there is her Rakshara form, where she becomes a warrior princess born for war.
In this form, she is clad in red and black armour and wields a red spear.
In that form, she bears the Mark of War on her forehead and the tattoo of battle on her face.
Her short hair and athletic build in that form made the blood of her sisters run cold.
She can maintain that for three hours every day.
She only awakened 25% of her bloodline.
The three forms of Rakshara are Prey, Slaughter, and Warrior.
But even though she is prey, the predator lies hidden behind her eyes.
"Moments like this make me wonder where you came from and where you are going, Kent," Neomi asked, looking fondly at Kent, who was getting his divine rod serviced by a Void Reaver.
Ingrid may have become a dangerous warrior, but when it came to her main, she was as tame as a cat.
"I came from the unknown, ladies, and I am rising to kill a god, for that is the mission I will accomplish in less than a century," Kent smiled.
"You want to kill a god?" Camilla raised an eyebrow.
"Indeed, my love.
I rose from the dead to kill a god, and I will kill him regardless of who he is or what authority he holds." The ladies turned and looked at him.
"You’ll be taking us with you, right?" Neomi asked, already pumped for a battle of that magnitude.
"Of course.
Killing a god is not one man’s job, after all," Kent smiled.
Though he will be killing a god, Vexthra still hasn’t told him why she wants the God of Alchemy dead.
But he doesn’t really care.
Vexthra is his wife, and as such, whatever she wants will be given to her—even if it involves killing a god.
"You ladies should stop being petty and let Kent awaken your True Names," Ingrid, who had had her fill of the dragon juice, said to Mara, Camilla, and Val.
They knew Unity wasn’t getting her True Name yet because she had a different arrangement.
Alina also isn’t getting the chance to break away from her master, who has much more to ask about Kent than focusing on managing her auction house and business empire.
This means they will have to pause the awakening here for now, mainly because the three who have yet to join the harem are being petty.
"If we’re being petty, then what about you all who wanted to have a second ’first time’ with Kent again?
Don’t you think something like that would also be welcome by us too?" Val stuck out her tongue, teasing the ladies.
"Your loss," Selene said, though she knew she would have done the same thing if she were in their place.
"No need to look down on us, sisters.
The moment we’re done with the rescue mission, this brat won’t have any more excuses to deny us anymore," Mara said, and the ladies nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 369: Crimson Harbinger, the Second Undead
paragraphs: Kent spent the rest of the hours on the outside, resting under a tree in his master’s residence. The more time he spent there, the more his anticipation grew for his second undead.
It’s already in the creation process, so he was rather happy and eager to see the outcome.
So, after a couple of hours, when the message finally appeared, his smile bloomed.
⟪Your second undead creation is now complete⟫
Kent quickly entered the tower and opened the Necro Forge. However, just before he could enter, Akira and Gaia appeared.
He knew they wanted to enter with him, so they did, and that was when they came face to face with the being that had appeared.
"Wow... That is one scary undead we have here," Kent said, meeting the gaze of a lady who was looking coldly at him.

He knew she didn’t mean to look at him like that, but the redness in her eye—or rather, the redness in her single eye, which appeared to glow intensely as she gazed at him—made him shudder in his boots.
He did not know if that was her eyes, just one red glow, but getting looked at by those set of dangerous eyes isn’t something to be taken lightly.
"Her name is Sylara, a Reaper and also the Harbinger of souls and blood. But I will call her the Bone Claw Reaper," Akira said with a smile.

She was the one who designed her, so she seemed happy watching her creation come to life. Of course, I had already started weaving skills for her, for she wanted all her creations to be the best of the best.
"This is one terrifying creation, Akira. I never expected the design to look this terrifying yet badass," Kent said, also smiling, for she was indeed a terrifying undead.
Sylara was clad in a form-fitting battle suit made of a dark, almost organic material. The armour has sharp, jagged edges that resemble the claws of a beast.
Red energy pulses through the veins of her suit, glowing intensely at her chest, hands, and knees. A hood covers her head, casting a shadow over her face.
Just looking at her appearance was enough to show just how monstrous the lady standing inside the forge was.

Her most striking feature is a glowing red eye in the centre of her hood, where a face should be. This eye radiates power, shifting slightly as though it were a gateway into the abyss where torment resides.
A long, tattered cloak flows behind her, moving like living shadows. Her gauntlets are clawed, her fingers ending in razor-sharp black talons with glowing red tips.
Her boots are armoured, and they look as dangerous as her claws. Kent stopped and imagined getting kicked in the face by her boots.
The world around her distorts slightly as if the air bends under her presence. But Kent knew from the information he received about her that the air around her was filled with the power of the abyss.
She is a creature of the abyss.
"Hi, can you talk?" Gaia asked, waving at the 2-meter-tall lady.
"Yes," she spoke, but the sound that came out was haunting, far from the sweet tone one might expect from a lady.
"Then, can you tell us something about yourself?" Gaia asked again.
Though Kent could appraise her and gather some basic information or read through the information he received from the tower, hearing it directly from her was much more intriguing.
"I am Sylara, a Crimson Harbinger. I am from the abyss and can harness abyssal energy at will. I have no last name and no relatives."
Her introduction was short yet concise. The chilling nature spoke was also worth addressing.
"Then, can you access all 13 levels of hell?" Akira asked.
"I can go as far as level 12. Level 13 doesn’t welcome me, for the Calamity of that place is against the undead."
"Do you have a home in hell?" Gaia inquired.
"No... I can only access and enter any of the 12 levels I have access to."
"What about the underworld?" This time, it was Kent who asked.
"The undead are not welcome in the underworld," she replied.
Her answers were simple and straight to the point. Kent nodded at her response, but he couldn’t shake the feeling that there was something more to her—something he couldn’t quite place.
"Do you have a second form?"

"No. A harbinger only has one form, and this is the form I will remain in for as long as I exist... And I am an undead so until you deem me not worthy to follow you, I will always remain in this form"
"I see. That can be changed later but for now, it makes sense, I guess," Kent sighed.
The lady before him is a Level 8 Root Ascension stage expert, but the energy surrounding her is more than enough to tell him she is not an easy cookie.
She has the nature of a killer, and looking through her skill set, Kent could tell she has more than enough to handle even a Root Sovereign like the bat he had fought with Kaizo.
He was just a Level 1 Sovereign, so killing such a being would be simple. However, he also knew if the Sovereign was at the 3rd level or beyond, then the battle wouldn’t be in her favour.
But there is a fix for that.
"How do you grow? Though I can upgrade you later, you must have a way to grow on your own right." Kent asked.
Kaizo grows by consuming treasures like metal ores, food, and anything that can be consumed.
"By drinking the blood of my kills. I only drink what I kill. Also, consuming the souls of those I kill helps me grow."
"That can be arranged," Kent smiled. "But do you have a specific type of blood you prefer?"
"Blood of dragons, master," the lady said, and Kent narrowed his eyes at her. Behind him, the two lolis were laughing at their master, who didn’t know they had a hand in his current predicament.
"You are messing with me, aren’t you?" Kent, who sensed something foreign from the lady, asked.
He knew Akira wouldn’t create someone without adding a personality such as this. So he check and behold, the Loli added such a personality.
The lady may be dangerous and terrifying, but she has personalities, and one of them is playful.
This was the only good thing about her, as the rest were not suitable.
Cold and calculating. Thirst for blood. Hungry for battle. Cursed Gaze.
Those are her fine qualities in Akira’s perspective, so there is no reason to make such a being benevolent.
She only seeks the dangerous aspects that will make her one hundred per cent focused in battle. But after the battle, she added a part that can make her relatable and that was her playful character.
"I don’t have any preferences, so provided the blood is from a being who is not lower than my realm, I will gladly consume it," she replied with no emotion whatsoever.
"I have more blood than you can consume. I hope you don’t have a thing against the blood of a bat," Kent asked with an evil smile.
The bat currently hiding inside his evil sect is about to have a nasty surprise. The dragon, who still holds a grudge against him, will do everything in his power to end its pitiful existence soon.
"I will be sending you to meet your teammates. One of them will request a spar with you. Accept after he bothers you for a while, but don’t kill him.
Although where you will be Fighting him has a no-killing formation, he has already died a couple of times.
He may be an undead, but he is not absolute in the brains."

chapters.title: Chapter 370: The Rescue Mission (1)
paragraphs: "Hello there, Nara. ’Tis I, Kent, your Prince Charming, speaking."
Nara was seated in a lotus posture and was cultivating when a smirk formed on her face as she heard Kent’s voice in her head.
She would be lying if she said she hadn’t missed the only voice that seemed to fill her with hope these past few weeks.
Though she had remained strong for the past 60 years, she had started to lose hope, seeing no end to her torment. But now, all that changed when Kent appeared in her life.
⟪I can already tell why the ladies are falling for you. You just know how to make a lady feel loved,⟫ Nara said, causing the bat Kent to smile in his head, of course.
Bats don’t smile. That would just be ridiculous.
"It’s only normal for me to make such a beauty as yourself feel loved. After all, you are stuck with me for years to come."
⟪You make it sound like I will fall for you. Let me tell you, aside from my sword, I don’t have any more feelings to give,⟫ she smiled.
"That’s what they all say until they can’t resist. But don’t worry, I will ensure you feel love deeply, of course."

⟪Shameless. I can already tell you’re a shameless individual,⟫ she said, her smile still on her face, causing the disciple of the Spear Gate Master, who seemed to be awake this time, to raise her eyebrow and start looking around.
It took her a few seconds, but she spotted the bat hanging on the wall.
She wanted to speak, but Nara subtly shook her head, causing her to hold back her words.
⟪She wants to hear your voice,⟫ Nara said, making Kent sigh inwardly before deciding to speak to her.

"Hello there. I am Kent, a friend of your master. She sent me to rescue you. Now, just sit there and show no happy expressions if you can’t be like Nara. But rest assured, you will be rescued by the end of tomorrow."
The lady sat there, unmoving. However, Kent and Nara could tell she was putting all her effort into holding back her emotions.
They had to wait three minutes before she asked a question.
⟪Mas-master, is she okay? Has she been eating well? I can tell you are not telling me everything. Has she fallen in love yet?⟫
She asked all the important questions she had on her mind during the years she was trapped in that cage.
"Your master is well, and yes, she eats good stuff every day. In fact, she enjoys it more than you think, and yes, she has fallen in love," Kent said.
He could tell the moment Zaila held his replay; she became very happy as teardrops started to fall from her eyes.
⟪Thank you, Kent. It’s good to hear she is well. I am happy now.⟫ She bent her head and started sobbing, just as she had done for all the years she had been down there.
⟪Just let her have her moment. Now, what did you want to tell me?⟫ Nara sighed.
"I just wanted to let you know that tomorrow, the rescue mission will commence, and you will be free by then.
But you must ensure that, until the last moment, you make no move to alert the sect master that something like this is happening.
Just be ready because you will have your life back after tomorrow."
⟪We will be ready, and please, be careful. I don’t want your pretty face getting hurt before I see it. I can’t tell how you look, considering you are a bat. So keep the face well until I see it⟫
The lady had to be given the award for being the best hostage. Despite her situation, now that she had hope, her life was full of strength and cheekiness.
"Don’t worry, my face will remain handsome forever. But I’m sad you only wanted to see my face; your sister was more concerned about something happening to my dragon rod."
Nara’s cheeks turned beet red upon hearing such a shameless comment from Kent. But the dragon just smirked and turned to Zaila.
Once again, bats don’t smirk, but you get the idea.
"Hi. Just relax and start counting the minutes. Soon—and when I say soon, in the next 20 hours—you will be getting out of here.
Your master will be very happy to see you, so put on a brave face and hold your shoulders high. You will be free soon."
After saying that, Kent bid them farewell and flew away. A few minutes later, he was back in his body. With a heavy sigh, he entered the tower, appearing inside the Legion Tower.
There, he saw Kaizo on the floor, panting.
"Buddy, you have suffered," Kent said, sitting down and tapping his shoulder.
"I want to grow stronger, Master. These two are not friendly at all," Kaizo said, pointing at Sylara, the Harbinger, who was now staring at Veydris, the Metal Knight.
Sylara is an Ascension stage expert, while Veydris is at the peak of the Transcendent stage. However, if the two were to fight, Kent knew Veydris would win simply because of his affinity to the Void.
His attacks are hard to defend against, so Sylara would be in a tight spot. But then again, Kent hadn’t seen the two in combat yet, so he could only wait for that day to happen.
"Don’t worry, buddy. You and I will soon be trashing an Ascension-stage human who has taken something that belongs to me," Kent said, making Kaizo jump to his feet and laugh.
"Just you and me, Master. I want to punch something," the dragon laughed.
"Yes. Just you and me" Kent smiled and then turned to the two weirdos
"Sylara, Veydris, come closer," Kent called out, and the two vanished, reappearing right in front of him, and stood beside Kaizo.
"I have a mission that requires you to babysit my women. And when I say babysit, make sure they don’t die. Leave the battle to them and only intervene when they are having a hard time."
Sylara nodded, but Veydris remained standing. However, he stabbed his sword into the ground twice, showing he had taken in the instruction.
"Get ready. I will call you when ready to move out."
Kent vanished and appeared inside Tower City.

However, if the two were to fight, Kent knew Veydris would win simply because of his affinity to the Void.
His attacks are hard to defend against, so Sylara would be in a tight spot.
But then again, Kent hadn’t seen the two in combat yet, so he could only wait for that day to happen.
"Don’t worry, buddy.
You and I will soon be trashing an Ascension-stage human who has taken something that belongs to me," Kent said, making Kaizo jump to his feet and laugh.
"Just you and me, Master.
I want to punch something," the dragon laughed.
"Yes.
Just you and me" Kent smiled and then turned to the two weirdos
"Sylara, Veydris, come closer," Kent called out, and the two vanished, reappearing right in front of him, and stood beside Kaizo.
"I have a mission that requires you to babysit my women.
And when I say babysit, make sure they don’t die.
Leave the battle to them and only intervene when they are having a hard time."
Sylara nodded, but Veydris remained standing.
However, he stabbed his sword into the ground twice, showing he had taken in the instruction.
"Get ready.
I will call you when ready to move out."
Kent vanished and appeared inside Tower City.

chapters.title: Chapter 371: The Rescue Mission (2)
paragraphs: Kent appeared inside the Tower City, where the Soul Sentinels and Saden were sparring.
Saden was sparring with Nyxira, the Silent Assassin. She is one of Elsa’s soul sentinels.
Since Saden uses a bow, the shadowy assassin is the best opponent to train her reaction speed and shooting accuracy.
Death is not permanent inside the tower, so they aren’t holding back their attacks.
"Big brother, I missed you!" The small human lady dashed toward Kent, jumping into his arms.
Kent, who had almost forgotten about her, smiled and swung her around, causing Li Hua to laugh and giggle, finally getting the big brother treatment she craved.
She had recovered from the death of her grandma thanks to Nyxira and the rest of the Sentinels, making her feel loved and cared for.
After swinging her around for a while, he set her down and looked to check whether she had grown taller. But to his disappointment, she was still the same height—not an inch taller.
"You’re growing," Kent said, trying to sound encouraging. Li Hua just looked at him and smirked.
"You’re a terrible liar, brother. I know I’ll never grow taller than this, so stop lying." Kent smiled guiltily but brushed her hair and assured her.

"Don’t worry. Smaller people like you tend to become the strongest when they grow." Though the Atomic Divine Body physique hadn’t awakened yet, she possessed it, and that was why she would never increase in height or size again.
But that would all change if she wanted to. She could just learn a transformation skill and temporary take on a bigger body if she wanted to.
"Big brother, watch this!" Li Hua retrieved a dagger she had hoisted on her waist and started flipping it between her fingers.
It was like someone who had used the dagger for years, for she was really moving it between her fingers skillfully, causing Kent to raise his eyebrow.
He didn’t expect something like that to happen, so he was taken aback.
"That’s awesome, right? Big sister Nyxira showed me how to do it," Li Hua said with a cute little smile.
"You are a genius Li Hua, a one of a kind Genius." The small human smiled, making Kent strangely feel a sense of happiness for her.
He lifted her onto his shoulder and moved toward the three Sentinels and the Night Rider, who had stopped sparring when they noticed his presence.
"You four have done well taking on the Malrics and their slave business" Kent said. They nodded in acknowledgement.
Their mission to handle the Malrics was more than a resounding success. They had completely eradicated their ranks, thanks to Saden’s ability to read the memories of the dead.
It was something she used extensively throughout the duration of their mission. So, when everything was over, even those who had done business with them years ago were killed.
"It had to be done to stop them," Saden said, like a righteous mage.
"Then be happy to know they won’t be the last slave traders you’ll be eradicating," Kent said with a smile. Then he turned serious.
"We have a mission this time, with everyone. However, you four will be moving with me and another teammate.
Though I don’t want to underestimate our opponents, the battle will be simple, so be ready. I will inform you when it’s time for the mission."
"We will be ready."
"Very well. I’ll see you later," Kent said to them before leaving with Li Hua.
"Big brother, I want to join the mission too. Last time, Big Sister Nyxira didn’t take me with them, so I want to join this one," Li Hua said, holding her small dagger like a professional.
Kent chuckled at her demand.
"You’re still too young to join this mission," he said, brushing her head. But Li Hua didn’t smile.
"But big brother, I can do this..." She spun the dagger through her fingers again, widening Kent’s smile.
"I know you can do that. However, this is a mission for your big sisters and brothers. I promise when you reach the stage, I will take you on all the missions I go on."
Li Hua didn’t like the rejection, but she understood where Kent was coming from, so she didn’t make things hard for him.
"You promised. When the time comes and you don’t take me, I won’t allow you to leave," she pouted, but Kent managed to calm her down.
"I’ll be going back now. Don’t neglect your training, okay? You’re doing great so far." Li Hua nodded as Kent vanished away.
His next destination was the various training towers for his ladies. This time, Gaia made it so Kent could enter without entering the training paths they were walking.
Inside their towers, there was a portal that led inside. Meaning they have a living space just like the rest of the towers.
But because she knew Kent might come there, she made it so the moment he or anyone entered, the owner would be notified. So, Kent told them all to come out after 16 days.
The mission would start in 20 hours, meaning they had 20 days to train inside the tower. After delivering the message, he left the tower and appeared outside.
The moment he did, Uncle Drew, who had been away for over two weeks, emerged from a black portal, radiating the presence of someone straight from hell.
Kent, who could tell he had become a Root Great Sage, smiled.
This also shows whatever he went to do in the underworld and Hell was a resounding success. He told him just like inside the tower, time in the underworld and hell already runs faster.
It’s even faster than the one inside the tower. So while only 21 days passed on the outside, a year or years might have already passed there.
Kent nodded at the aura around him.

"You’re right on time, Uncle Drew. The mission is ready. We move out in 20 hours," He said to his Night Rider Captain, who had become stronger after spending years in the underworld, transforming 2 Transcendents and 6 Great Sages into hell demons.
"How did it go, Uncle Drew?" Kent asked, and Uncle Drew smiled.
"It went better than I hoped, Master. If possible, I want to get my hands on more people to take there" he said, his smile widening.
"Looks like you had a great success this time" Uncle Drew nodded.
"I met someone in the underworld who helped me greatly. Now, I have two Ascension-stage Hell Demons and six Transcendent-stage Hell Demons.
And thanks to this person, the hell demons are not like their human forms. They have become several times stronger and deadlier."
"Damn, Uncle Drew. Who was this person who made you smile so cheerfully? In fact, who was this person who went out of their way to help you become this monstrous?"
Kent asked, also smiling. If what he said was indeed the case, then this person was worth knowing and perhaps befriending.
"They call her the Queen of the Underworld, but she said her name is Nyx, the Ruler of the 9th Level of the Underworld," Uncle Drew answered, and Kent raised an eyebrow.
’Nyx, huh...’

chapters.title: Chapter 372: The Rescue Mission (3)
paragraphs: Kent would love to know more about this mysterious Nyx, but that could wait, as the mission was important. She helped his subordinate, meaning he must thank her someday.
"We will talk about this Queen of the Underworld later. For now, let’s discuss the mission," Kent sighed.

"This mission is already in the bag. I have created another undead who is at the 8th level of the Ascension stage. She alone is enough, but since the ladies want to join the fight, she will just babysit them.

However, now that you are here, I’m not sure where to place you. Whether you join the mission or not, we will be able to rescue the two ladies, so why don’t you join the ladies and help them on the side, too?
I will be moving with Kaizo, Saden, and the three Sentinels. This means we will take on the Ascension-stage evil practitioner hiding down there."
Kent just didn’t know if he should laugh or cry. When he received the quest to save the two ladies, the odds he found out were on another level.

However, now that he was ready, he just couldn’t help but wonder just what his presence there would do, considering he has someone like Kaizo, Veydris, Sylara, Neomi, Selene, Ingrid, Lilian and Elsa on the team.
They are just too overpowered now, and he just could think of how ridiculous it seems to pit them all against the sect master.
Even Uncle Drew felt how ridiculous it looked.
"I understand, young master, but I will let one of my Hell Demons go with you. He won’t join the mission; he will just ensure you are not harmed.
Please don’t reject this. I know you suffered during your battle with the Evil Sect, so let me leave him with you. He is a shadow, so he will just hide in yours," Uncle Drew insisted.
Kent could only nod.
If his Night Rider wanted to do that, then it was fine. He naturally didn’t need it, as he wouldn’t even be fighting if everything fell within his calculations.
"Then be ready." After finalizing everything, Kent went to relax. He would be the one to enter the underground cave physically.
But the moment he did, the sect master would notice his presence, which meant he had to act fast.
He relaxed and waited until only one hour remained. That was when he brought everyone to the Legion Tower.
"I will bring you all out when I appear inside the cave. Sylara, you should release your presence the moment you come out. This will scare the bastard from approaching the two ladies.
This means he will run. But don’t worry about him running. Just release your presence.
However, while he might run, his minions won’t, so you ladies know what to do. The two ladies are the priority, so get to them first and take them inside the tower.
You can clear the underground cave and go back inside the tower when everything is done. I hope we all understand what to do."
From his ladies to his undead, everyone nodded.
"Very well. I will bring you out in the next hour." They moved away and began to wait.
Mara and Camilla got closer to him and hugged him. "Be careful, Kent. Your safety is also very important to us."

"Don’t worry, I have measures in place to ensure my safety." After kissing them, Kent went back to the sect, and with his casual clothes on, he left the Sword Gate and headed to the Tasty Home Pavilion for a quick bite.
Leaving there, he moved toward the mansion of the sect master in casual steps. All those who saw him didn’t suspect he was going on an important mission that would save the sect in many ways.
After 55 minutes, he arrived 2 kilometres away from the sect. That was when he stopped and looked toward the mansion in the distance.
"Your time is up, Sect Master. All the years spent doing all kinds of evil to people comes to an end today."
He moved again and was soon 1 kilometre from the mansion. He stopped once more and used the [Rule Breaker] skill, cancelling all effects of formations on him.
He wanted to teleport inside, so he negated all formations that would prevent his teleportation. When the skill was applied, he blinked and appeared under the blood cauldron hanging by thick chains.
It didn’t even take a second, but the sect master sensed his presence, and like a god, he activated his minions.
But Kentt was also a step ahead.
Sylara, the Harbinger, was brought out. Immediately, as she emerged, she unleashed her level 8 Root Ascension stage aura, which filled the space with its tormenting pressure.
The cavern shuddered, and all the openings that were made into fake walls collapsed as monstrous beings began running out.
The reaction time was quick, but Kent was a step ahead. He teleported again and appeared beside the cages held by the chains.
The two ladies who felt a shift In the air when Sylara unleashed her presence were upstanding.
"Ladies, your Prince Charming is here," Kent smiled and brought out his ladies, Uncle Drew and Veydris.
"He is running, so I’ve got to go." He winked at Nara, who held a shocked expression on her face when her eyes fell on her sister, Mara.
It’s been like a dream, but now, it was a reality right infront of her.
The fake walls opened, and monstrous beings emerged. Clad in her Rakshasa form, Neomi sprang into action immediately, followed by her sisters.
"Big sister Mara, you and Camilla should free the ladies," Selene said, and then she took her battle form.
The slaughter began.
But it would end sooner than they expected.
Kent appeared inside a large space, and that was when he came face to face with the sect master, who was activating an artefact.
"You can’t run, Sect Master. Just give up and accept your death," Kent said as he brought out Saden, Kaizo, and the three Soul Sentinels.
They leapt into action and began slaughtering the minions surrounding them.
In fact, Kent hadn’t expected the mission to go this smoothly, especially considering the look of panic on the sect master’s face.
What he didn’t know, however, was that Sylara had done more than release her presence. She had used a skill that consumed all the Root Transcendent stage minions under the sect master’s control.
This was why he was more than scared when Kent appeared.
"DIE!" The sect master threw an item at Kent, but Kaizo blasted it with his lightning before it could reach him, filling the air with poison.
At the same time, the sect master was bathed in a green light and vanished with mocking laughter.
"I will kill you all" Those were his last words before he vanished.
In his mind, he had escaped. However, he failed to notice he came after someone who had a celestial tower at his disposal and a vengeance to exact.
Kent was meant to save the ladies but couldn’t allow the sect master to escape. His mission was to ensure he died...
Yet, when he did, a smile appeared on Kent’s lips.
"Saden, ensure everything is taken care of here. When you’re done, join the others and go back to the tower. We’ll be back."
An item appeared in his palm, which, if looked at closely, resembled the one the sect master had used.
"You can run, but you can’t hide." His smile widened, and then, like a ghost, he and Kaizo vanished.
The next second, they appeared atop a mountain with a vast sea on one side and a dense forest on the other.
The sect master, who had managed to escape, now found himself face-to-face with Kent once again.
"Well then, Kaizo, do you want to go first?"
