chapters.title: Chapter 373: Who Is the True Evil (1)
paragraphs: "Thunderclap!"
Kaizo shouted, jumping high into the air as he unleashed a powerful clap that shot a thick lightning bolt, landing heavily on a dome created by the sect master.
The next second, Kaizo moved with a thunderous boom, unleashing a powerful punch that shattered the dome into countless pieces.
"Rapid Slash!"
Before the sect master could recover from Kaizo’s punch, 450 sword arcs rained down on him, pushing him back a couple of meters.
The sword arcs fashioned from sword qi landed a few cuts on his body. This caused his fury to explode even more.
Kent and Kaizo decided to start the battle with punches and slashes instead of talking it out with the sect master, who was doing his best to understand where it all went wrong.
He had been careful, making sure nobody suspected a thing, but in the end, he was found out. The most painful thing was that he never suspected a thing.
That was just too painful for him, for he never knew all these years that his cover was blown and that the people he was close to were the same people who would bring his downfall.
Perhaps it was out of guilt, but he saw the two gate masters as her main allies inside the sect.

Of course, he knew nothing about the relationship between Mara and Nara, but he trusted her mainly because Camilla was with her, and he knew it was thanks to her that Camilla recovered after her disciple died.
So he saw them as her allies, but he never expected them to know of his treachery all these years.
Now, swinging at him was the disciple he had next to be added to his collection of geniuses, and he just didn’t know what to think.
He was making preparations to go after Kent and add him to his blood banks, but now, the same brat was giving him a good beating, and he just couldn’t wrap his mind around it.
"Quaking Fist!" Kaizo’s fist grew as he charged at the sect master.
Boom!
His fist landed on a defensive barrier, shattering it yet again.
This time, the sect master was a step ahead and waved his staff, forcing a wraithlike figure to appear and charge at Kent, who was moving toward him.
He knew if the brat and the brute kept him contained for a few more minutes, he wouldn’t have a chance to change the scene of the battle, so he unleashed his trump card.
"Kaizo, handle him for now. I’ll deal with this thing first," Kent said as he moved back and studied the wraithlike figure.
He scanned it with his Enchanted Eyes.
⟪Name: Evil Soul Spirit⟫
⟪Grade: Peak Transcendent⟫
→ An evil Soul Spirit formed from using a ritual that combined the souls of 10,000 unwilling beings.
→ It possesses the powers of all the beings added and can take any form it desires.
"That is just too evil yet genius," Kent muttered.

An evil smile appeared on his face as he swung his sword, sending arcs at the evil soul spirit. However, just when the attack was about to land on its body, the evil soul spirit dispersed into a mist of shadow, evading the attack.
It then became whole again and charged at Kent, forcing the dragon to move back once more. The soul spirit was no small foe.
But Kent didn’t allow the setback to impede what he had in mind for the sect master. His plans will never change.
Since the sect master had only brought out a single soul spirit, it likely meant he could only summon one at a time.
But he also had to find a way to kill it. Of course, as an Alchemist, he knew how to purify things, so he knew what to use against such a spirit.
"In that case, why don’t we heat things up?" Kent’s sword was engulfed in flames as he took aim at the wraith again. This time, his attack landed, causing the spirit to screech in pain.
"That works," he said, moving in.
The next second, the sky was filled with blue flame arcs. He was using his pill flame, the Blue Void Flames, so the hits hurt quite a lot.
He turned and glanced at Kaizo, smiling.
Kaizo was relentlessly punching the sect master, forcing him to create one defence after another.
The sect master was gritting his teeth, sweat dripping down his face as Kaizo’s fists rained down like a storm.
The brute who had suffered at the hands of Veydris and Sylara was exacting his revenge on the poor sect master.
Each punch cracked the air, sending shockwaves that shattered the ground beneath them. He jumped up and struck his fist forward.
The sect master raised his staff, summoning a glowing barrier, but Kaizo’s strike smashed through it like glass. This forced the sect master to move back and start distancing himself from the brute.
"You can’t keep running!" Kaizo roared, his body crackling with lightning. He leapt into the air again, his fist glowing with raw energy. "Thunder Hammer!"
The sect master barely dodged, the ground exploding where Kaizo’s fist landed. Rocks and dust flew everywhere, but the sect master didn’t let a small opening that appeared go to waste.
He swung his staff, and a wave of dark energy surged toward Kaizo. He crossed his arms, blocking the attack, but the force pushed him back several feet.
Meanwhile, Kent was locked in a deadly dance with the evil soul spirit. The wraith lunged at him, its claws slashing through the air.
He sidestepped, his sword trailing blue flames. He swung, and the flames engulfed the spirit, making it screech in agony. But it reformed instantly, its shadowy form twisting into a monstrous shape.
Kent didn’t want to admit it, but he envied the sect master for having such an evil entity. Killing it was proving to be more taxing than he expected.
"A valuable minion to have. Too bad you were made by a scum," Kent muttered.
He raised his sword, and the Blue Void Flames surged brighter. "Let’s see how you handle this!"
He slashed downward, and a wave of blue fire erupted, engulfing the spirit. The flames burned hotter, turning the air into an inferno.
The spirit writhed, its form flickering as it tried to escape, but Kent didn’t let up. He swung again and again, each strike sending more flames to consume the wraith.
The flames were the only things affecting it somewhat, and Kent was doing his best to handle it so he could get back to the plans he had for the sect master.
Meanwhile, far from the battlefield, a beautiful lady clad in dark clothes and covering her hair with a dark cloth stood calmly, watching the battle unfold.
She was the Kingdom Protector who had befriended Kent.
"Looks like your time has come, Victor," she muttered. "So much potential, yet wasted in the pursuit of power. At least your death won’t be a huge loss to the kingdom."
She sighed in her heart and continued to watch Kent and his undead trash the sect master Victor, the once-genius who turned to evil simply because he was cuckolded.

chapters.title: Chapter 374: Who Is the True Evil (2)
paragraphs: The story of the sect master goes back several decades.
He was the up-and-coming genius, the heir of a renowned noble family from the Athea Kingdom. He was the prodigy who became a disciple of a famous mage who had participated in the Battle of Parting.
He was on track to becoming one of the most powerful mages of his time.
Then he met a young lady, and everything changed for him.
At first, he was happy, for the beauty he met was one to die for. They envied him—his peers envied his talent and his love interest.
But while he held his shoulders high for a while, all of that came crashing down when his wife chose to follow a long ear she met on the ancient battlefield of Parting.
That was when he became furious, and in his attempt to get his woman back, he fell into despair. He wasn’t able to defeat the elf that stole his woman, so he turned to evil.
He began following the path of darkness, and for years, under the guise of a genius mage, he used all kinds of nefarious means to grow his power.
His plan was to become a Sovereign, and once he achieved that, he would invade the land of the elves and get his woman back.
He was still deluded into thinking he would get his woman back, even though that would never be the case.
His battle with the elves caused the elven race to declare humans their enemies, and since then, whenever they met on the ancient battlefield of Parting, they would try to kill one another.
But he never stopped. Over time, the Kingdom Protector became aware of his dark arts, but she did nothing to stop him, for she wasn’t concerned with the petty squabbles of individuals.
To her, she would only intervene when actions threatened the entire kingdom.
But she kept her sights on him, and now, watching him get trashed by Kent and Kaizo, she could only sigh.
Victor swung his staff, summoning a barrage of dark orbs that shot toward the Brute.
Kaizo dodged and weaved, his movements a blur.
He closed the distance in an instant, his fist slamming into the sect master’s chest. The impact sent him flying, crashing through the trees like a bulldozer.
But Sect Master Victor didn’t last long on the ground. He pushed himself up, his eyes glowing with fury.
"Just why? Why had everything gone so wrong all of a sudden?" he screamed.
He slammed his staff into the ground, and the earth trembled.
Cracks spread across the ground, and dark energy erupted like a geyser. The moment the dark energy erupted, both Kent and Kaizo felt the danger.
"Kaizo, don’t let the energy touch your skin... It’s poisonous," Kent warned, and Kaizo obeyed.
"Bathe in Lightning!" Kaizo’s body was covered in lightning armour, which made him appear like a divine juggernaut.
He had become majestic yet dangerous, for the lightning armour around him was very powerful.
Kaizo braced himself, his body glowing with lightning. "Bring it on!" he shouted, charging forward. The two clashed, their powers colliding in a blinding explosion of light and darkness.
The mountain they were fighting on cracked in half, with one part falling into the sea while the other slowly crumbled apart.
But the battle was far from over. The sect master has proven to be formidable. However, his foundation was as solid as it should be.
But thanks to the dark arts, he had become formidable with a lot of evil skills in his arsenal. But it’s too bad he found someone like Kaizo to be his opponent.
That was his only misfortune. Because the brute was all about punching. And while he would love for him to fall into his trap, Kaizo was just too monstrous.
Kent, knowing that if this continued for much longer, they would be forced to change their plans, glanced at the wraith and sighed.
"If you won’t die, then you can go chill somewhere for now," he muttered. The battlespace artefact appeared in his palm, and without hesitation, he pulled the wraith inside.
"Simple. The moment your master dies, you will die too," he said with an evil smile as he looked at the sect master.
"Kaizo, you know what to do."
"Really? I’m still having fun here, Master. He is like the pinching bag that comes once every decade," Kaizo said, landing a punch on the sect master’s chest, making him vomit blood.
"I know you’re having fun, but don’t let that get to you. You’ll have many chances to play in the future. For now, let’s torture this bastard."
"Very well," Kaizo sighed. "Since that’s the case, then I can only do my best to torture him."
"Overdrive!" His energy surged, and his speed increased, moving at a pace that caught the sect master completely off guard.
"Behind you," Kaizo said, forcing the sect master to look back. But he regretted that action, as the moment he turned, a thick spear made of lightning stabbed into his chest.
"Never turn your back on your opponent," Kaizo said with a smile that was heartbreaking for the sect master, who seethed and gritted his teeth, drawing blood.
"I know you probably still don’t realize what’s happening. But don’t worry, dying without knowing how it happened is also a good thing, for it makes things simple for you in the underworld."
Kaizo landed another attack on his body, sending him flying down.
"Your move, Master," The brute said, smirking. Kent vanished, and the next second, a painful cry filled the peak of the broken mountain.
A dark shard stabbed into the chest of the sect master. But it didn’t stop there—two more stabbed through his thighs, making Kent smile.
"Don’t look down. Stand up, for the battle hasn’t ended yet," Kaizo said as he descended from the sky, landing heavily on the sect master’s leg.
The bone broke, and his leg twisted at an unnatural angle. The painful cry that escaped him came from his very soul, for the pain was just too much.
"It’s just a broken leg. No need to cry about it," Kent said, commanding another shard to stab through his hands.
"Master, why don’t we let him stand first? I feel like attacking while he’s on the floor is bullying, and we don’t bully people, right?"
"Indeed. We only bully bats, and he’s not a bat," Kent replied with a thoughtful expression.
"You’re in luck. Use this chance to recover so we can continue," Kent said with a smile, and Kaizo smirked.

"On the other hand, I have this skill that will get you going for a while, so why don’t we apply it?" Kaizo extended his finger, and dark gold lightning shot from it, landing on the sect master’s chest.
The next second, he was back on his feet, causing the master and subordinate to smile evilly.
"Well then, shall we?" Kent asked.
"Yes, we shall."
Just like that, the evil practitioner was face to face with two beings who looked more innocent than evil, yet they were the most evil beings you would ever meet.
Protector Vari looked at the torturous fight and couldn’t help but ask herself, "Who is the true evil?"

chapters.title: Chapter 375: Finally Rescued
paragraphs: A few seconds before Kent and Kaizo went after the sect master...
"Ingrid, don’t let any of these filthy creatures get close to our sisters," Neomi, now in her War Princess form, said as she unleashed a powerful swing of her spear, sending dark beams of energy.
Upon impact, the creatures’ bodies were reduced to dust.
But she wasn’t idle. She was on the move, embodying the essence of a war princess. She was killing the creatures faster than Lilian, Unity, Ingrid, and Elsa could keep up.
"This is just too much. I’m even scared of her," Elsa muttered.
They formed a barrier around their sisters, who were currently overwhelmed with emotions as they stared at Nara and Zaila.
They were fighting against the swarming creatures emerging in overwhelming numbers.

The sect master, startled by the sudden resistance, commanded all his creatures to swarm the ladies. He knew he could escape but wouldn’t want the ladies telling the whole world he was an evil cultivator.
So he set loose his minions to come after the ladies and get rid of them.
However, Neomi wasn’t giving them any chance. She moved like the wind, her movements smooth and swift, and her killing was devastating, to say the least.
Among all her sisters, aside from Vexthra, who is a goddess, Neomi is the next most monstrous. And right now, they were all watching her kill like a machine.
"Void Devouring!" Ingrid’s eyes shone, and the void cracked, swallowing five monsters whole. They reappeared through another path, away from the one Neomi was fighting on.
Mara, Camilla, Nara, and Zaila were not in the right mindset to do anything, as their emotions were on another wavelength. They stood there, staring at each other, unable to help themselves.
Mara and Camilla, now face-to-face with Nara and Zaila, couldn’t help but let their tears run down their faces.
"Big sister," Mara muttered, staring at her sister, who was also shedding her fair share of tears.
"Zaila," Camilla called out to her disciple, who was making crying sounds despite a tube still stabbed through her neck.
"Master... is that really you? I’m not hallucinating, right?" Zaila asked, unwilling to accept the answer if it wasn’t what she hoped for.
"It’s me, Zaila. It’s your useless master who couldn’t even protect you from evil," Camilla broke down then and there.

Her guilt for trusting the sect master and letting Zaila fall under his wing was something she had regretted for years. Now, seeing her in chains and being used as a blood bank, she was utterly shattered by the sight.
She couldn’t handle it.
"Ladies, while the crying and shedding tears are all cute and touching, why don’t we rescue them first?" Neomi, who had taken on her Rakshasa form, said with no emotion whatsoever in her eyes.
She was as cold as ice. That was her nature, and she was living it.

But what she said was indeed sound advice. Standing beside Camilla, Selene swung her sword, and like cutting through butter, the chains binding the cages were severed. She took another swing, and the cages were opened.
"Let’s do it slowly, else the tubes will hurt them," Val, the only normal human among the ladies, said as she carefully removed them.
Lilian, Unity, and Ingrid are already engaged in combat with Selene, Elsa, and Val, helping the two caged ladies.
"Selene, take them away," Neomi instructed, and Selene nodded. She then turned to Elsa, who knew her soul-healing abilities would be needed.
Elsa could tell their soul energy was depleted, so she joined Selene and the two gate masters to take the ladies into the Harem tower.
The moment they were gone, Neomi started issuing orders.
Uncle Drew and Veydris stand on the side while Sylara fights somewhere away.
"Lilian, you and Unity should take that way. I’ll handle this one, while Ingrid takes care of the last opening," Neomi said, ready for action.
"Hey, what about me?" Val, who was left standing, asked.

"Oh, you’re still here? Then take the other opening. But I’m not sure any creatures will come from there, considering Ingrid has already cleared it," Neomi smiled despite being in her War Princess form.
"You..." Val pouted, not getting any of the action.
Selene and Elsa left with the four ladies, while Unity and Lilian moved together, leaving only Val behind.
"Val, don’t mind her. Just free the beasts in the cages. If they’re beyond saving, end them quickly," Unity said to the arrogant Sword Saintess.
"At least one of you is still sensible," Val chuckled and sped away.

Like the warrior she was, Neomi smirked and moved swiftly, killing the creatures left behind by the sect master. Ingrid and the rest of her sisters were doing their best to handle their share of the creatures.
Ultimately, it took them less than five minutes to kill everything, considering Sylara had already taken care of the Transcendent-level creatures. They only had to deal with the small fries.
"Are they all dead?" Unity asked. Ingrid nodded after using her void eyes to scan the entire cave.
"However, there are some treasures hidden within this cave. We should collect them for Kent," Ingrid said. The three ladies with her nodded, and they left to investigate what she was referring to.

Meanwhile, Val managed to dispose of all the beasts inside the cages. She could tell they were suffering and would continue to suffer if she freed them. So, she ended their misery and stood staring at the large cauldron filled with blood.
"That is something evil," Unity said when she, Lilian, Ingrid, and Neomi appeared at the scene.
"Indeed. Should we destroy it?" Lilian asked.
"No. Let’s wait for Kent to decide," Ingrid answered. "But let’s collect the other treasures." They moved away and began gathering anything they deemed valuable.
Inside the Harem Tower, Nara and Zaila were now passed out and submerged in the Yin pool, with Mara and Camilla beside them, ensuring they would wake up surrounded by people rather than in a cage.
Elsa and Selene stood in front of the pool, silently staring at them.
"They really suffered," Elsa said. She could sense their shaken spirits thanks to her high affinity for the soul. For someone to have a shaken soul meant they had endured immense pain.
Nara was a Root Sage at the 7th level when she was captured, but now she had regressed to a Root Great Sage at the 4th level.
Zaila, who was at the 3rd level of the Sage stage, had also regressed to level 5 Root Great Sage.
Zaila had been turned into a blood bank over two decades ago, while Nara had endured this torment for over six decades.

It was a miracle Nara had only regressed one stage. This also highlighted her extraordinary talent, as she had found the will to continue cultivating despite her dire circumstances. However, this did not diminish the pain they had endured.
"I hope Kent and Kaizo torture that bastard for an entire day," Selene said, clenching her fist as she imagined the pain she would inflict on the sect master if given the chance.
"Knowing Kent, I’m sure we’d even feel bad for the bastard if we witnessed what he’s doing to him right now."
"He deserves it. It’s too bad these two ladies won’t get the chance to kill him themselves," Elsa said, turning to look at Selene.
They both nodded and then Selene communicated with Neomi, who accepted their proposal.

Back atop the mountain where the battle had taken place, Sect Master Victor was riddled with holes. His body was pierced in numerous places, his left eye gouged out, and both legs broken and bent at unnatural angles.
Upon closer inspection, his right hand was missing its fingers, which appeared to have been pulled out from the bones.
His left ear was severed, and the corners of his mouth had been cut, giving him a grotesque, joker-like appearance.
Kent, the architect of this torturous ordeal, looked at his handiwork and smiled.
"I want to kill you, but that would be mercy. So why don’t I—"
Cracked
Kent was about to send him into the tower prison when the space cracked open, and four ladies appeared through it.
"Kent dear, why don’t you hand him over to us," Neomi said with a smile while Ingrid closed the void.
"Lilian, do it."

sentences.text: A few seconds before Kent and Kaizo went after the sect master...
"Ingrid, don’t let any of these filthy creatures get close to our sisters," Neomi, now in her War Princess form, said as she unleashed a powerful swing of her spear, sending dark beams of energy.
Upon impact, the creatures’ bodies were reduced to dust.
But she wasn’t idle.
She was on the move, embodying the essence of a war princess.
She was killing the creatures faster than Lilian, Unity, Ingrid, and Elsa could keep up.
"This is just too much.
I’m even scared of her," Elsa muttered.
They formed a barrier around their sisters, who were currently overwhelmed with emotions as they stared at Nara and Zaila.
They were fighting against the swarming creatures emerging in overwhelming numbers.
The sect master, startled by the sudden resistance, commanded all his creatures to swarm the ladies.
He knew he could escape but wouldn’t want the ladies telling the whole world he was an evil cultivator.
So he set loose his minions to come after the ladies and get rid of them.
However, Neomi wasn’t giving them any chance.
She moved like the wind, her movements smooth and swift, and her killing was devastating, to say the least.
Among all her sisters, aside from Vexthra, who is a goddess, Neomi is the next most monstrous.
And right now, they were all watching her kill like a machine.
"Void Devouring!" Ingrid’s eyes shone, and the void cracked, swallowing five monsters whole.
They reappeared through another path, away from the one Neomi was fighting on.
Mara, Camilla, Nara, and Zaila were not in the right mindset to do anything, as their emotions were on another wavelength.
They stood there, staring at each other, unable to help themselves.
Mara and Camilla, now face-to-face with Nara and Zaila, couldn’t help but let their tears run down their faces.
"Big sister," Mara muttered, staring at her sister, who was also shedding her fair share of tears.
"Zaila," Camilla called out to her disciple, who was making crying sounds despite a tube still stabbed through her neck.
"Master... is that really you?
I’m not hallucinating, right?" Zaila asked, unwilling to accept the answer if it wasn’t what she hoped for.
"It’s me, Zaila.
It’s your useless master who couldn’t even protect you from evil," Camilla broke down then and there.
Her guilt for trusting the sect master and letting Zaila fall under his wing was something she had regretted for years.
Now, seeing her in chains and being used as a blood bank, she was utterly shattered by the sight.
She couldn’t handle it.
"Ladies, while the crying and shedding tears are all cute and touching, why don’t we rescue them first?" Neomi, who had taken on her Rakshasa form, said with no emotion whatsoever in her eyes.
She was as cold as ice.
That was her nature, and she was living it.
But what she said was indeed sound advice.
Standing beside Camilla, Selene swung her sword, and like cutting through butter, the chains binding the cages were severed.
She took another swing, and the cages were opened.
"Let’s do it slowly, else the tubes will hurt them," Val, the only normal human among the ladies, said as she carefully removed them.
Lilian, Unity, and Ingrid are already engaged in combat with Selene, Elsa, and Val, helping the two caged ladies.
"Selene, take them away," Neomi instructed, and Selene nodded.
She then turned to Elsa, who knew her soul-healing abilities would be needed.
Elsa could tell their soul energy was depleted, so she joined Selene and the two gate masters to take the ladies into the Harem tower.
The moment they were gone, Neomi started issuing orders.
Uncle Drew and Veydris stand on the side while Sylara fights somewhere away.
"Lilian, you and Unity should take that way.
I’ll handle this one, while Ingrid takes care of the last opening," Neomi said, ready for action.
"Hey, what about me?" Val, who was left standing, asked.
"Oh, you’re still here?
Then take the other opening.
But I’m not sure any creatures will come from there, considering Ingrid has already cleared it," Neomi smiled despite being in her War Princess form.
"You..." Val pouted, not getting any of the action.
Selene and Elsa left with the four ladies, while Unity and Lilian moved together, leaving only Val behind.
"Val, don’t mind her.
Just free the beasts in the cages.
If they’re beyond saving, end them quickly," Unity said to the arrogant Sword Saintess.
"At least one of you is still sensible," Val chuckled and sped away.
Like the warrior she was, Neomi smirked and moved swiftly, killing the creatures left behind by the sect master.
Ingrid and the rest of her sisters were doing their best to handle their share of the creatures.
Ultimately, it took them less than five minutes to kill everything, considering Sylara had already taken care of the Transcendent-level creatures.
They only had to deal with the small fries.
"Are they all dead?" Unity asked.
Ingrid nodded after using her void eyes to scan the entire cave.
"However, there are some treasures hidden within this cave.
We should collect them for Kent," Ingrid said.
The three ladies with her nodded, and they left to investigate what she was referring to.
Meanwhile, Val managed to dispose of all the beasts inside the cages.
She could tell they were suffering and would continue to suffer if she freed them.
So, she ended their misery and stood staring at the large cauldron filled with blood.
"That is something evil," Unity said when she, Lilian, Ingrid, and Neomi appeared at the scene.
"Indeed.
Should we destroy it?" Lilian asked.
"No.
Let’s wait for Kent to decide," Ingrid answered.
"But let’s collect the other treasures." They moved away and began gathering anything they deemed valuable.

chapters.title: Chapter 376: Fury of Vixens
paragraphs: Kent was planning to send the Sect Master into the tower, where he would extend his torture until the ladies had recovered and were ready to handle him personally.
But that plan was put on hold when space cracked, and through the Void, Ingrid, Lilian, Neomi, and Unity appeared.
Val, Veydris, Sylara, and Uncle Drew were left behind to handle whatever might have been hidden down there.
Of course, everything was cleared out.

These four never planned to come after the sect master, but thanks to Selene and Elsa monitoring the state of Nara and Zaila, they contacted them and let them go and, in place of Zaila and Nara, inflict more damage on the Sect Master.
However, instead of using the harem connection to move to him, Ingrid wanted to show off her skill. So, like a god, space cracked, and the four ladies appeared; he welcomed them.
Obviously, Kent knew what they were after, so the moment they appeared, he knew there was no stopping them.
However, what happened next was something he had never seen before.

The Sect Master was hurt and broken from all the beatings he had received from Kent and Kaizo. One eye was blinded, both legs were broken, and his left arm was also broken, while his body was littered with holes.
Yet, the moment they appeared and Neomi gave the order, Lilian raised her staff and cast a tier 7 spell that instantly healed the Sect Master.
His legs were healed, his arm was restored, and even his eye was healed.
However, the pain he was in was multiplied, and just from the moaning sound coming from his mouth, Kent could tell he was in pain—a very agonizing pain.
But that pain wasn’t something Neomi cared about.

In her Rakshasa form, she could go on for five hours. However, that form was for battles, for she is a war child. So, instead of tainting her image as a warrior, she changed from Rakshasa to Shara, the killer.
Her armour shifted to dark red, her spear now exuded red blood energy, and the look in her eyes caused the Sect Master to shudder.
Lilian was in her Ice elemental form, but the moment the healing spell took effect, she changed into her Fire elemental form.
Kent warned her not to take her dragon form or demi-dragon form, for he knew he was being watched.
The tower had informed him Lady Vari, or as one would call her, Protector Vari, was around and watching everything.
As for Ingrid, she was in her hybrid form, where she was both a Voidling and a human. Like Lilian, Kent told her not to take out her Void Hound.
That will be exposing too much.
However, that was enough to handle a scum such as the Sect Master.
Unity just stood on the side, calmly watching her three overpowered sisters handle the Sect Master.

"You have made some people very sad due to your hunger for power. This is why you will suffer before dying. And don’t think about killing yourself. In my presence, death only listens to me," Neomi said, and even Kent felt the chill.
But that was one of her abilities as a child of death. In the presence of Shara, one cannot kill themselves. They won’t have the will to kill themselves, or she is the one meant to do the killing.
Then it began.
She moved and swung her spear, forcing the Sect Master to raise his staff, but before he could defend, a spear shot from out of nowhere and grazed his side, cutting a deep wound.
Ingrid was far from Neomi, but her attack connected, thanks to the Void. She sent the attack through the void.
"AAARRRGGHHH!"

The Sect Master screamed as his left eye was engulfed in flames. Lilian, who was also standing back, pointed her staff at him, and as the red gem in her staff began to glow, the pain became more intense.
Kent sighed, and Kaizo shook his head.
He and Kent had their fair share of torturing the Sect Master, but he never expected these beauties to be this aggressive.

"Master, perhaps we should learn from the one with the red eyes. I can tell all her cuts are shallow, but there’s just something about them that makes my spine tingle," Kaizo said, making Kent nod in response.

"I was thinking the same. All her cuts are in places where even the smallest cut will be agonizing." The Sect Master was probably asking for him and Kaizo back, for Neomi and her sisters were doing far more torturing than he and Kaizo had done.
Within five minutes, the Sect Master was riddled with cuts, and his body was bathed in blood from all the wounds inflicted on him.
Unity was just standing on one side, watching her sisters with a smile.
"You ladies should wrap it up," Kent said, and Neomi turned to look at him.

"Should we kill him now or bring him back for when the ladies wake up?" Selene had already told them Nara and Zaila were resting, so she wanted to find out if they should be the ones to kill the evil man.

"Just finish him. The trauma they went through is not something they can recover from easily, and I feel like telling them to kill this man themselves will bring back some unpleasant memories. So, kill him," Kent sighed.
His first plan was to let the two ladies kill the Sect Master, as Alina did with Turyn, but after thinking it over, he didn’t want them to go through that.
He had asked Nara before how she wanted the Sect Master to die, and she said as long as his remains were burnt to ashes, she would be happy.
His existence should be erased everywhere, and his name should not be spoken again. She wanted that, and he was sure Zaila wanted the same thing.
So, it would be best if Kent handled this instead of allowing them to do it.
"Just do it in your own way," Kent added, and that was all the ladies needed to hear.
"Void Cut," Neomi muttered as she swung her spear. Instantly, another scream filled with pain escaped the Sect Master’s mouth as his left arm was cut off.
"Disintegrate," Lilian followed, and while Ingrid cut off his hand, Lilian’s spell engulfed both his eyes in flames. Like frying an egg, they were fried and disintegrated from his face.
"Swing of a Thousand Cuts," Neomi continued. With a single swing of her spear, a thousand cuts, each cutting deep into his body, landed on the Sect Master, turning his scream into a hoarse cry.
"Haunted Arrow," Unity, who had been calmly watching her sisters, chose to let the Sect Master feel her pain as well. She unleashed an attack, and while Kent knew her to be lovely, her arrow wasn’t.
It went through the Sect Master’s mouth, cutting off his scream. It was, as they say, very haunting.
"Ingrid, finish him."
"With pleasure."
Ingrid’s eyes turned darker, and with a gentle step, the Void cracked again. This time, it cracked underneath the Sect Master, pulling him in.
She then snapped her fingers, and it closed. Just like that, both the body and soul of the Sect Master would forever be trapped inside the Void for all eternity.

chapters.title: Chapter 377: Quest Complete, Rewards
paragraphs: After years of evil deeds, the legend of the evil Sect Master was over. However, the pain he left behind wasn’t something that could be cleared in a day.

The trauma, the pain, the memories—these were not things that could be erased easily. But the most important thing, which was the Sect Master himself, had been taken care of, thanks to the vixens doing their best to ensure he was sent away in the most agonizing way possible.
Ingrid, Neomi, Lilian, and Unity were very thorough with their kill, so there was no way such evil would find its way back.
Now, the legacy of the evil Sect Master would forever remain inside the Void.
Kent, who could only sigh after seeing what the ladies had done, turned and faced the large expanse of sea stretching beyond the limit of his gaze.

"So, this is the Dark Sea," he said, already looking forward to when he would cross it and witness its dangers. It was the sea that divided the various continents, and within it were thousands of terrifying sea beasts.
After looking at it for a few more minutes, he sighed and turned to Ingrid. "Kindly take us back, dear."
Ingrid nodded, and the next second, she opened the Void and pulled them all through it. It closed behind them, leaving only the mess caused by the battle as a reminder of what had transpired.
After they left, the Kingdom Protector appeared.
"Just who are those ladies, and where are they from?" The display they had given her was enough to convince her that they were not normal humans.
"Just what is it about that kid and the people that surround him? First, it was that brute, now, these four ladies"
Kent had displayed some remarkable skills that left her stunned. But in the end, it was Unity, Ingrid, Neomi, and Lilian who had caught her interest and left her wondering about so many things.
But since no one was there to answer her questions, she could only sigh and leave. She would keep an eye on Kent, and perhaps, if she was worthy, she would learn something about them one day.
Kent and the ladies reappeared inside the underground cave where Veydris, Sylara, Uncle Drew, and Val were waiting for them.
After handling their task, Saden and the three Soul Sentinels were already back inside the tower.
"What should we do with this blood cauldron?" Uncle Drew asked.
"Let’s dispose of it," Kent replied without hesitation. Right now, the Sect Master was dead, so everything linked to him had to be wiped out completely.
"Then let me." Ingrid stepped forward and opened the void yet again, pulling the Cauldron inside.
"That is very convenient of you, Ingrid," Kent smiled.
"Then, the mission is over. We should all head back inside the Tower. I will go back to the sect and later join you."
They nodded and left. Kent sighed and went back to the Sword Gate, where he immediately entered the Tower.
He appeared inside the Harem Tower and quickly found the ladies at the Yin Pool.
Upon reaching there, he saw Nara and Zaila passed out, with Mara and Camilla beside them, supporting their bodies as they recovered.
"How are they?" Kent asked.
"All physical and internal wounds have been healed. Right now, they can only sleep and wake up when they want," Elsa replied, making Kent nod.
"They deserve that much sleep. After what they went through, I wouldn’t be surprised if they slept for a whole month or two." He took a deep breath.
"You can go back to your training if you want, for they will be sleeping for a while."
"We will wait for them to wake up," Selene replied, and the ladies nodded in agreement. Kent nodded.
"Then, in that case, I will be busy with a few things, so let me know when they wake up." They nodded, and he left. He went back to the Sword Tower.
He sat down and pulled out the messages he had received.
The first thing he saw was the quest completion message.
⟪Congratulations on completing the quest ’Clash with Evil.’ Your rewards have been released.⟫
⟪Rewards: Received⟫
→ 20,000,000 Tower Points
→ True Name Token (Five)
→ Memory Key
The plan was to finish this quest before awakening the True Name of his ladies. However, he had to do it after obtaining the True Name tokens through other means.
Now, he has five more True Name tokens. This means he can awaken five more ladies, considering he had already made provisions for Val, Alina, Mara, and Camilla.
Even Vexthra has a True Name token to her name, which he will use the moment he brings her into the Tower the next time he visits her.
He wondered if he could place her inside the Tower during his next visit, but Gaia explained that it had to be a process because she was from a higher world.
This process involved creating a channel she could use to enter the Tower.
That process will begin the moment Kent visits her next time. This also means soon, she will have a specialised true name for herself.
Aside from that, he now has three Memory Keys. This means the chances of him learning more about his past as Jest, the Sword Progenitor, are guaranteed.
Strangely, all three keys have been code-marked with the name (Jest), meaning they can only be used for his memories as Jest.
Not that he was upset or anything. This was enough for him to take his swordsmanship talent to the next level.
He had already seen the effects when he used the first Memory Key, so while he knew this would be a smooth ride, he couldn’t help but wonder what would happen next.
He was undoubtedly excited about this. It felt almost too good to be true, but he knew it was legit.
"This is great," he smiled, then looked at the next messages in the same quest.
Thanks to the additional requirements added, now that he managed to complete the rescue within 30 days, he received additional rewards.
⟪Additional Rewards: Received⟫
→ Celestial Dew of Rebirth x2
→ Memory Key (Chaos Dragon)
→ Undead Schematic Creator x2
→ Undead Schematic x2
→ Dungeon Seeker Card Upgrader
→ Dungeon Master Token x4
→ SS-Ranked Dungeon Seeker Card (One Dungeon)
"Damn..."

Upon reaching there, he saw Nara and Zaila passed out, with Mara and Camilla beside them, supporting their bodies as they recovered.
"How are they?" Kent asked.
"All physical and internal wounds have been healed.
Right now, they can only sleep and wake up when they want," Elsa replied, making Kent nod.
"They deserve that much sleep.
After what they went through, I wouldn’t be surprised if they slept for a whole month or two." He took a deep breath.
"You can go back to your training if you want, for they will be sleeping for a while."
"We will wait for them to wake up," Selene replied, and the ladies nodded in agreement.
Kent nodded.
"Then, in that case, I will be busy with a few things, so let me know when they wake up." They nodded, and he left.
He went back to the Sword Tower.
He sat down and pulled out the messages he had received.
The first thing he saw was the quest completion message.
⟪Congratulations on completing the quest ’Clash with Evil.’ Your rewards have been released.⟫
⟪Rewards: Received⟫
→ 20,000,000 Tower Points
→ True Name Token (Five)
→ Memory Key
The plan was to finish this quest before awakening the True Name of his ladies.
However, he had to do it after obtaining the True Name tokens through other means.
Now, he has five more True Name tokens.
This means he can awaken five more ladies, considering he had already made provisions for Val, Alina, Mara, and Camilla.
Even Vexthra has a True Name token to her name, which he will use the moment he brings her into the Tower the next time he visits her.
He wondered if he could place her inside the Tower during his next visit, but Gaia explained that it had to be a process because she was from a higher world.
This process involved creating a channel she could use to enter the Tower.
That process will begin the moment Kent visits her next time.
This also means soon, she will have a specialised true name for herself.
Aside from that, he now has three Memory Keys.
This means the chances of him learning more about his past as Jest, the Sword Progenitor, are guaranteed.
Strangely, all three keys have been code-marked with the name (Jest), meaning they can only be used for his memories as Jest.
Not that he was upset or anything.
This was enough for him to take his swordsmanship talent to the next level.
He had already seen the effects when he used the first Memory Key, so while he knew this would be a smooth ride, he couldn’t help but wonder what would happen next.
He was undoubtedly excited about this.
It felt almost too good to be true, but he knew it was legit.
"This is great," he smiled, then looked at the next messages in the same quest.
Thanks to the additional requirements added, now that he managed to complete the rescue within 30 days, he received additional rewards.
⟪Additional Rewards: Received⟫
→ Celestial Dew of Rebirth x2
→ Memory Key (Chaos Dragon)
→ Undead Schematic Creator x2
→ Undead Schematic x2
→ Dungeon Seeker Card Upgrader
→ Dungeon Master Token x4
→ SS-Ranked Dungeon Seeker Card (One Dungeon)
"Damn..."

chapters.title: Chapter 378: Additional Rewards
paragraphs: First, Kent now has over 10 Dungeon Master Cards that will allow him to claim over 10 dungeons after he clears every last floor.
This also means the moment he clears all floors and claims them. He will have the chance to summon all the last-floor bosses later in combat.
Obviously, Kent knew this was the universe trying to make him an offer he couldn’t refuse—and damn, he wouldn’t reject such an offer.
Having the ability to summon the last floor boss of any dungeon cleared was something any cultivator would die for.
However, he only has one burning question that he needs an answer to.
"Gaia," he called.
The cosmic loli appeared, along with her sister Akira. They seemed to be in the middle of a squabble but quickly became attentive when they materialized.
Kent just shook his head, watching their expressions. They are the oldest in the universe, yet they behave like children.

"Tell me, Gaia. After claiming a dungeon—say, a Tier ’A’ dungeon where the last-floor boss is at the Peak Root Transcendent stage—would this floor boss rise to the Root Ascension stage if I upgrade the dungeon later?
I have the means to upgrade dungeons yet to be claimed, so there should be a way to upgrade those already claimed, right?"
Kent was a greedy bastard.
He knew a Transcendent could be helpful to him in this low-level world.
However, the moment he transcended to a higher world or found himself on a quest in a higher world, a Transcendent wouldn’t be much use to him.
This meant he would have to discard the dungeons after leaving this world.
But he didn’t want to do that.
The dungeons, he would claim, would serve as training grounds for his undead, wives, and legion. He knew his forces would soon number in the hundreds, and he would need a way to train them.
These dungeons would come in handy.

But, as with the quest that just ended, when Sylara appeared, the battle was over. So, obviously, he wanted dungeons where he could let someone like Sylara face opponents she couldn’t slack off against.
Upgrading claimed dungeons was the next best thing he could hope for.
If he could keep upgrading the dungeons, then that means he would never run out of training grounds.
⟪Master shouldn’t worry. When you claim your first dungeon, you will know how to upgrade it. Of course, as a spoiler, you will need millions in Tower Points, so don’t worry too much about that.⟫
"In that case, why don’t I upgrade the Dungeon Seeker Card from Tier A to Tier S, so I can have ten dungeons with last-floor bosses at the Peak Root Ascension stage?"
He upgraded the card, and a smile appeared on his face.

"I now have this card that will give me access to ten dungeons, another Tier S card, and now, another reward for a Tier SS card. This means I can claim 11 Tier S Rank Dungeons and an SS Rank dungeon."
⟪Congratulations, Master,⟫ both Gaia and Akira said, smiling.
Kent smiled and retrieved the Undead Schematic Creator cards and the Undead Schematic cards—four of them—and gave them to Akira.
"You already know what to do." Akira smiled and stored away the cards, causing Gaia to look at her with a narrowed expression.
Akira just shrugged her off.
If Gaia was free, he would have perhaps shared it among them. But because she has two more training towers to work on, Akira will have all four cards.
"By the way, Gaia, will the tower city be ready by the time the two ladies wake up?" Kent asked.
⟪It’s ready, Master. You told me to get it done before the rescue mission, so I got it done. We can explore it after you are done checking your rewards and the rest of the messages.⟫
Kent nodded and then focused on the rest of the rewards.
"A new memory key for my memories of another life, huh? That is rather convenient. I can finally know more about my dragon side and how it will affect my cultivation." Kent smiled.
⟪Congratulations once again, Master. With this key, you will realize your potential as a Chaos Dragon.⟫
Gaia smiled. This was her moment because she was obsessed with the Chaos Dragon when Kent used the first key. She wanted to see him become a dragon...
Now, her dream was about to be realized.
Kent ignored her and focused on the most important reward of them all. Perhaps he should have checked that first.
⟪Celestial Dew of Rebirth⟫
→ A dew collected from the Celestial Fruit of Rebirth. Drinking it will make one undergo rebirth.
→ Those who drink it gain a purified soul, removing past weaknesses, and their potential skyrockets, allowing them to break past previous limits effortlessly.
"Wow. If this is just the dew, then what would the main fruit look and behave like?" Obviously, Kent turned to Gaia, who just smirked.
⟪I am a cosmic weaver, Master, but the universe still regulates me, and as such, not everything can be taken by me. So don’t look at me like that.
If you want a Celestial Fruit of Rebirth, go to the Celestial Gardens. I’m sure that bitch guarding the place will be happy to see you.⟫
Kent could see the teasing on her face, so he knew she was being serious yet nonchalant. This made him start to think about the Celestial Garden.
If only he knew the dangers surrounding that place, he would have sympathized with the God of Alchemy, who was an unfortunate victim there a couple of hundred thousand years ago.
But since he doesn’t know that, he will only learn it the hard, hard way one of these days. Perhaps that will set him straight...
"Akira, send these two dews to Selene. She should give them to Nara and Zaila. Since their souls and foundations are shaken, this will be a great help for them."
Akira took the two dews in a jade bottle and vanished.
She appeared inside the harem tower, where the ladies were now inside the pool, attending to the two ladies.
"Master said you should give this to the two ladies," Akira handed the bottles to Selene.
"What is he doing now?" Neomi asked.
"Let’s just say Master plans to go to a place he shouldn’t. But since we want to see him suffer for a moment, we won’t stop him," Akira smiled, causing the ladies to raise their eyebrows.
"Just don’t send him somewhere he can’t return to us in one piece," Neomi said. Akira nodded to her words and vanished back to Kent, who was about to review the next quest he must embark on.
The moment he opened it, his smile froze.

chapters.title: Chapter 379: First Calamity Level Quest
paragraphs: Among all the things Kent was expecting, the quest he had received wasn’t one of them. He never expected this, and after reading the lengthy descriptions, he just couldn’t believe his eyes.
⟪You have received a Universe Quest⟫
⟪Quest Name: Shadow Guardian of Planet Dusk⟫
⟪Quest Type: World Quest⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Calamity⟫
→ Planet Dusk was once a bustling world filled with billions of Duskborn—humans with darkened, shadowy skin and glowing violet or crimson eyes.
→ There were millions of powerful cultivators. The world was thriving, and everyone was happy.
→ Though they only had one Planet Protector, the threat they faced wasn’t something that required protection.
→ They were the most peaceful you could ask for.
→ But that all came crashing down 15,000 years ago when the Obsidian Dark Demon Ant Queen Elxn of Planet Kuynx invaded this peaceful world, and everything changed for the worse.
→ Billions couldn’t make it, for the magnitude of the battle was just too devastating.
→ The battle lasted for 200 days, and when they finally managed to kill the Ant Queen, 90% of their warriors were wiped out, and 60% of the race was decimated.
→ But they won, as it should be. However, before the queen died, she left a package for them.

→ The Ant colony was left behind, and it was meant to mature 7500 years ago, of which the infamous Ant King Ketu and his thousands of Obsidian Dark Demon Warrior Ants were meant to finish what she started.

→ However, the universe believed in fair chances, so it turned the colony into a Dungeon to buy the world of Dusk a chance and set restrictions on it that prevented it from causing any harm to the Duskborn.
→ They must first grow and build their strength back to the stage where they can face such a hidden threat.
→ But every good thing comes to an end.
→ Two years ago, Ant King Ketu broke through to the Core Formation stage; thus, it has risen to the stage where the restrictions of the Ant Dungeon could no longer hold it.

→ In two years, the restrictions will be broken, and the strongest being the World of Dusk has ever seen will be unleashed, with hundreds of Root Sovereigns, thousands of Root Ascensions, and tens of thousands of Root Transcendents raining down on them.
→ This cannot be allowed to happen, for the Duskborn are one with the universe, and as such, they must be protected.
→ This means you must become a guardian again and prevent a calamity from befalling them.
→ The universe has picked you to become her weapon against these terrors.
→ You have two years to handle this threat and ensure the world of Dusk, who is unaware of such a threat hanging over them, never knows they narrowly escaped a great calamity.
→ Below are the details of the dungeon and the reward for completing the quest.
⟪Rank: SSS⟫
⟪Levels: 32⟫
⟪Power Levels: Root Transcendents - Core Formation⟫
⟪You can enter the dungeon at will. Just will it, and you will be teleported inside.⟫
→ There will be rewards for clearing every level, but below are the overall rewards after clearing the entire dungeon. The hidden rewards mean they will be revealed after the quest is over.
⟪Rewards:⟫
→ 1 Billion Tower Points
→ True Name Tokens (20)
→ Five Destiny Memory Keys (Unity)
→ Ten Memory Keys (4 diff. Incarnations)
→ Ascension Platform
→ Hidden Rewards (Ten)
Kent was left stunned, for this was just too much for someone like him, despite knowing this was meant to happen when he became the son of the universe and was granted the Universe Quest Pool.
But now that he had received this quest, he could tell shit had just gotten real.
"An SSS rank quest, huh... That is a huge one," he sighed.
⟪I wouldn’t say the master was unfortunate, for this is a big opportunity for you. The odds are indeed against you, but these will prepare you for the dangers that will come.
Facing hundreds of Sovereigns will be a good way for you to measure your strength against odds that just can’t be ignored.
Also, you will be getting some good Sovereign bodies for your undead. I can already see hundreds of undead warriors moving at your command.

But if that isn’t all, after defeating this Ant King, you will not only have a Core Formation stage warrior on speed dial, but you will also have a powerful dungeon future legions will be able to train in.
For now, plan well and face this with determination. The rewards are just too good to be ignored.⟫
Gaia said, and Kent could only nod. Like she said, this was a huge boon for him, for this is where shit gets real. If he wants to prepare for the apocalypse, he must face the dangers of this quest.
⟪Plus, you already have material to create 6 more undead and 12 dungeons you can use to train with your ladies before this quest begins.
2 years is over 40 years inside the tower, so you have enough time to prepare. Just make good use of your tower, for this is a big game for you, and you must play it.⟫
Akira also added her voice, and Kent could only smile.
"You two are the best. I guess we must rescue Dori next to reunite you three sisters."
⟪Of course, we are the best. And don’t worry about that slacker. Not even gods can kill her⟫
Kent smiled.
He knew if this quest was as it was described, then this was his chance to prove to the universe that he was qualified to be the guardian once again.
"Let’s go explore the city," Kent suggested, and the two lolis nodded. The quest was a good one, but the mechanisms behind it weren’t something simple.
The beautiful lady sitting at the universe’s core smiled when she saw the ready expression on Kent’s face.

"Some destinies are meant to be remembered and reawakened." The image of Unity appeared: "She once laid down her life for her people, and now a world that also lost its protector has triggered her destiny."
The smile on her face bloomed.
"She was once known as a warrior with the bow, for she was the best archeress in the universe. She was known as Love, the protector who laid down her life for her people.
Now she must awaken her destinies and become who she once was and who she was meant to be."
She snapped her finger, and far away into the cosmos, inside a dungeon, a key appeared on the first floor, which entered the body of a level 3 Root Transcendent Obsidian Dark Demon Warrior Ant.
"Your aim will determine your destiny, sister... I look forward to when you awaken."

chapters.title: Chapter 380: Tower City
paragraphs: After finishing everything up, Kent and the two cosmic beings teleported into Tower City.
Gaia made sure they appeared atop a mountain several kilometers away from the city, where everything would come into view.
In reality, the mountain they appeared on is part of the city, for it has a garden with several fruits already ripe. The garden was meant for relaxation.
This means he and his ladies can come there if they want the view.
But the view is something that is in abundance, for the city he was staring at wasn’t something that could be found anywhere in the universe.
Gaia is a Cosmic Weaver.
She can see everything inside this universe and, if allowed, outside this universe.
This means she has the power to see every village, town, city, country, world, starfield, galaxy, and the entire universe whenever she wants.
And so, using the Tower City builder that Kent gave her, she looked and picked from the billions of views in the universe and created her own.
The cloud buildings. Yes. There are buildings in the clouds.

The rivers, pools, and everything you would expect from the modern world could be found there. There are the herb gardens, the cultivation havens, the inns, and everything else a cultivation world has to offer.
She blended everything together to bring Kent’s vision to reality. Kent wanted to bring a modern world and a cultivation world together when he first awakened the tower.
He wanted to merge those two into his tower, which only he and his people would enjoy.
Basically, he wanted to blend many cultures into one and make it a reality, and right now, Gaia has started that.
Some cultural aspects of Earth can be seen there. There are others he will learn about later.
The diamond grounds, the glassy environment, the lush green gardens, the tranquility of it all, and the happiness he was feeling as he stared at it all.
"This is beautiful," Kent couldn’t help but say as he looked at the clean, modern, futuristic, yet medieval lush city lying before his eyes.
⟪When it comes to building stuff, I am your gal, Master.⟫ Gaia puffed her chest out, showing she was indeed the gal when it comes to building new things.
"You, indeed, are the best. I can tell you have put a lot into it. However, I have a question," Kent looked at Gaia strangely. He saw something that warranted an explanation.
"Why is there an image of you at that gate that reads, ’Sheriff Gaia’? I don’t recall asking you to create a replica of Texas."
⟪Since you are busy with stuff, I can only step in and act as the law of this city. With me around, there will be law and order here.⟫
"But the city is empty. Aside from us and the ladies, nobody else knows such a majestic place exists."

⟪Yet. For now, these are the only people you trust enough to show this world. But you are forgetting something: this is just the Human continent. There is a whole world out there where you will meet new people.
Some will need your help, in which case you will become their guardian. Knowing you, more ladies will come, and that means more people to fill the city.
You also have the Legion Tower, where you have already started growing your force. Though you planned on building barracks for them, this city will be like their relaxation space.
I can go on and list more, but the more you explore this world and even ascend to higher worlds, the more people you will have in your circle. You don’t have to look at it now; focus on the future.
Meaning, when the time comes, you will need a law enforcer, and who better to do that than the Mayor of the city... this gal.⟫
Gaia’s cute smile made Akira want to pinch her nose, but she knew Gaia would instinctively punch her, and that wouldn’t be good for the tower.
"Fine. Just know that as the mayor and sheriff of this city, you are obligated to ensure its development and growth. Do your best to make sure it keeps running and keeps developing."
⟪I have a generous donor, so don’t worry. I will ensure the city keeps growing for years to come.⟫ She smiled, and Kent just smirked.
He knew his tower points were in trouble, but he didn’t care. Soon, he will be swimming in tower points, so he can only let her do as she pleases.
"Let’s check it out before bringing the ladies." Thus, the dragon and his two assistants started to tour the city, going from one place to the next.
⟪The restaurants will be operated using androids. But since we don’t have any residents yet, they are all empty.⟫
Kent nodded.

Back on Earth, some restaurants had robots acting as waiters, so he knew that could be implemented. Of course, he knew androids are basically humans in machine form, as he had experimented with that topic in one of his movies.
’I had so much fun writing the movie. Oh, how I miss being a director,’ his mind wandered back to when he was a director back on Earth.
Now, he was in a cultivation world, and he wasn’t upset about it. If anything, he was much more excited about having the ability to be with women now.
After reminiscing about the past for a few seconds, they moved on and continued to explore the city for a while.
When they were done, they went back to the mountain garden.
"I love it. Now, work on building the Harem Tower too. You already know what to do, so make it happen." Gaia nodded.
⟪I can weave a few soul threads into the city, which will allow those who will be staying in it to become more attuned with the soul energy of the universe.
This means everyone who stays inside this city for a while will automatically become a soul cultivator.⟫ Akira proposed, and Kent accepted in a heartbeat.
"Feel free to do that. But first, why don’t we go create the third undead, and then we can go save Dori, your sister?"

chapters.title: Chapter 381: Creating The Third Undead, Making a Wish
paragraphs: If only Kent knew the class he casually imagined when Akira asked him would one day become this monstrous, perhaps he would have asked for much more than just this.

Akira had told him what she could do when she was first summoned, but never in his wildest dreams did he expect this to be the outcome when he asked for a class where he could create an undead legion.
But now, standing before the panel and creating a new undead, Kent just couldn’t believe his eyes.
⟪This time, the undead will be a male,⟫ Akira said, retrieving an undead schematic from which she had modified an already unique undead created by the universe.
One good thing about the undead schematic is that it only creates one-of-a-kind undead. There isn’t a second version of them out there, for they are unique to Kent and Kent alone.
Akira activated the card, causing a projection of a figure to appear.
"This one looks very menacing just from his image; I wonder what kind of powers he will have," Kent muttered, looking at a towering figure with white and red skin and two large horns on his forehead.
⟪He will also have brute strength like Kaizo, but unlike Kaizo, who uses his fists, this one will use chains as his weapon.
And because he is being created from a shard of the darkness crystal and domain crystal, he will also have an affinity for the abyss, just like Sylara.
However, he would be much different if the modifications I made were perfectly integrated. Basically, you will be getting another powerful figure you can use for your quests.⟫
"That is convenient. Then let’s start the creation process." The forge came to life, and the process began. After making sure all the required items were added, Kent started the process.
"Hmm, this one, too, will take 48 hours. That will be a while if I stay inside the tower," he scratched the back of his head.
"Why don’t we go save your sister first? The two ladies are still not up, so we might as well spend the time doing something productive."
The two ladies with him nodded, and they left the forge and went back to the mountain garden.
⟪How are you going to save her, Master?⟫ Gaia asked. In response, Kent retrieved one of two cards he had in his possession.
"By making a wish to the universe, of course," Kent smiled. He had received two cards that allowed him to make a wish, and the universe would grant it.
He already has two wishes left with the Enchantress, but these ones are different, and right now, he just wants to use one on Dori, the third weaver, who is the mind weaver.
"But before that, why don’t you answer this question?" Kent looked at them.
"Gaia can literally see everything that goes on in the cosmos. You can literally weave the strings of fate if you wish; this means your sister, a weaver, is also overpowered.
So why can’t she escape the prison she was in? Second, why can’t you just pick her up like you do with treasures?"
Gaia had told him what had happened to her sister, and from her description, it was clear that she had been captured.
But she is a mind weaver, someone who can use her thinking abilities to escape, so why didn’t she?
Second, he isn’t stupid. He knew if he trained harder for years, the chances of him defeating either of the two ladies would be basically nonexistent.
He doesn’t need a genie telling him that. Then, if that is the case, why can’t she just blast open the prison she was in and escape?
And lastly, if Gaia can see her and knows where she is, then why can’t she just pick her up like a sack of potatoes?
These questions really need to be asked, and Kent is asking them right now.
⟪The answers to your questions are rather simple. A weaver cannot use their powers against anyone in this universe. I am a cosmic weaver, but I cannot go against anyone.
I can easily kill a god since I can see them without realizing my presence. But that doesn’t mean I can just attack and kill them. The moment I do that, I will be a weaver no more.
But even without that, I just don’t have the power to attack or use my powers against anyone, not even against my sisters.
First, if Dori were to use her powers against her captors, she would cause more harm to the fabric of the world she was in, and perhaps, many would perish without her even knowing.
That is the power of a weaver. We have been created as absolute beings, but we are powerless children if you ask me.
A single punch from me can shatter galaxies, but doing so would be very bad for this universe, for we are created from the core of the universe.
Perhaps, if we are outside the confines of this universe, we can freely use our powers, but while inside, it would mean us destroying this universe. None of us want that.⟫
"I think I get the gist of it. In that case, under no circumstance should the two of you use your powers to come to my aid.
I won’t be happy about saving me while millions or perhaps billions perish," Kent said, and the two ladies nodded.
Truth be told, he wouldn’t want the two small humans to become his weapons for battle.
Gaia is literally creating training spaces for him and his ladies thanks to the tower, and Akira is like his personal skill and class artisan.
Asking them to do battle is just being too selfish.
"I guess I will make the wish now and see where that takes us." He drips his blood on the card and says his wish out loud
"I wish for the third weaver, the mind weaver, to be rescued from wherever she is in the universe and be brought to her sisters."
The card shone immediately, and a message appeared before Kent’s vision, making him scratch the back of his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 382: Saving Dori (1)
paragraphs: ⟪The universe has granted your wish. The universe deems your request too shameless, so you have received a quest.⟫
⟪Quest Name: Saving Dori⟫
⟪Quest Type: Eradication⟫
⟪Quest Difficulty: Very High⟫
→ The one named Dori is being held by the Crimson Vipers, an elite bandit force made up of various beastkin.
→ They are a danger to all who travel through the Ghandy Valley. Thousands have died by their weapons, and many families have been divided due to their treachery.
→ To save her, you must destroy the Crimson Vipers and free all prisoners.
→ Remember, the strongest among them are three orcs, all at the Root Sovereign stage.
→ Aside from them, there are 10 Root Ascension and 56 Root Transcendents.
→ The rest are just small fries.
⟪Rewards:⟫
→ 20 million Tower Points
→ Dungeon Master Card x3
→ Undead Schematic Creator
→ Dungeon Seeker Card Upgrader x2
→ Hidden Reward
"This is just too convenient," Kent smirked, knowing this wasn’t how he expected the wish to go. He expected Dori to be whisked away and brought to him inside the tower.
But now, he must embark on a mission.
Naturally, he knew the universe was messing with him. Strangely, he found it amusing.
⟪Good luck on your mission, Master. I can already see you having fun.⟫ Gaia and Akira giggled despite this mission being about saving their sister.

But it was understandable, considering even a god couldn’t kill Dori despite her being harmless to even flowers. This means for another billion years; she wouldn’t die as long as this universe still is there.
Kent snorted and chose to handle the mission now, considering he had received the power to open a portal to where he needed to go.
Using his connection with his undead and the others, he summoned Kaizo, Sylara, Veydris, Uncle Drew, Saden, and the three soul sentinels to the mountain garden.
He even added the four Battle Dolls he had bought during his battle with the evil sect.
"Are we going on a mission, Master?" Kaizo asked immediately as he appeared atop the mountain.

"Yes. A new mission has arrived, and this one is out of this world. So, you all should be prepared. We are going to a world of beast-men, but not to play around. Instead, we are going to kill some people," Kent smiled.
"I am already packed and ready to break some skulls." Kaizo’s fist crackled with lightning.
"Relax, Kaizo. You must first see the description before jumping to conclusions." Kent shared the description of the quest with his undead and Night Riders.
Strangely, he could do the same with the three Soul Sentinels. They are Elsa’s soul sentinels, but he has the same authority Elsa has over them.
"These are indeed some odds, but from the way I see it, you and I will handle one Sovereign, Veydris will handle another, and Sylara will take the last.
This will be like a warm-up for when we meet the bat again." Kaizo had already set his battle plans in motion, and the rest nodded.
"Kaizo is indeed right. I can handle two Ascension; my Hell Demons can handle the rest. Saden and the three, along with the metal dolls, can handle the Transcendents.
The small fries can be handled by my mount, who has also become Transcendent like me." Uncle Drew seemed to like the battle plan, too.
"What about your ladies? I can tell the one with the red eyes loves to fight, so why not bring her too?" Sylara strangely wanted Neomi to come, but Kent shook his head.

"Though she is going to be pissed when she hears there was a battle and she wasn’t invited, she is currently helping her sisters take care of the two ladies we rescued, so we must do this without her.
Plus, we have dungeons to explore after this mission, so she will have loads of battles to fight soon."
They all nodded at his words.
"In that case, we are ready to embark on this mission, Master," Kaizo said, and the rest nodded again.
"Very well." Kent snapped his fingers, and a portal opened. Without any hesitation, he stepped in, and the rest of his legion followed.
The moment they passed through the portal, they appeared atop a different mountain where a large expanse of forest could be seen stretching far and wide.
Most of the plants in the forest had pink leaves, and the energy in the air was much more powerful than that of Sonix, the world Kent lives in.
He quickly scanned the world using his enchanted eyes. He had gained those eyes after absorbing the Kingdom Builder books from the Enchantress.
That quest is also pending, for he knew one day, the Enchantress will ask her favour, and he cannot turn her down. But for now, he can only enjoy the benefits.
⟪World Name: Fedora⟫
⟪Rank: High⟫
⟪Strongest Existence: Tyrant Orc King Balma (Level 6 Spirit Lord)⟫
"I know you all can sense the energy in this world. That is because this world is a high world, while the one we came from is a medium world," Kent said.
"But soon, we will ascend to a higher world and start to travel to more worlds of even higher ranks. So get a feel for it now, for you will be getting more later."
He turned his focus back to the next set of messages that were all about the world. Basically, this is a world ruled by beasts and monster races.
They have different kinds of beasts, each with a powerhouse rooted in this world.
However, the strongest existence is the Tyrant Orc King Balma, a powerful being whose tyranny spreads far and wide.
He rules over the majority of this world, and while there are other powerhouses, because of his strength, they can only bow to him.
This caused Kent to sense something fishy and true to his feelings; when the description of the forest before them appeared, he got his answer.
"There is good news and bad news," Kent smiled, causing his legion to look at him strangely.
"The one we are coming to save is in the deepest prison in that direction. However, before we can get to her, we must first kill three Orc generals, who are the level three Sovereigns.
Now, the bad news. This world is ruled by someone we cannot survive a single attack from. And if we kill even one of the three Level 3 Orc Generals, that being will sense it and come after us."
Kent was smiling while saying that. One could already see the craziness in his eyes.
"I don’t know about you, Master, but I want to see such an existence and perhaps exchange a punch or two," Kaizo said, and like a maniac, Kent’s smile bloomed.
"Let’s move out. We have three orcs to kill."
